name: Absorb Elements

time.condition: which you take when you take Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder damage

entries: The spell captures some of the incoming energy, lessening its effect on you and storing it for your next melee attack. You have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to the triggering damage type until the start of your next turn. Also, the first time you hit with a melee attack on your next turn, the target takes an extra {@damage 1d6} damage of the triggering type, and the spell ends.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The extra damage increases by {@dice 1d6} for each slot level above 1.

name: Accelerate/Decelerate

time.condition: which you take when you see an attack roll hit a creature within 60 feet of yourself

components.m: a drop of oil or molasses

entries: This spell accelerates or decelerates an attack (see the chosen effect below) the instant before it strikes, lessening or multiplying its force.

entries.name: Accelerate
entries: The target takes an extra {@damage 2d6} damage from the attack. This extra damage is the same type dealt by the triggering attack.

entries.name: Decelerate
entries: Reduce the damage the target takes by {@dice 2d6} (to a minimum of 0 damage).

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The extra damage or reduction in damage increases by {@dice 1d6} for each slot level above 1.

name: Acid Rain
entries: With a gentle patter, corrosive raindrops build to an acidic deluge in a 20-foot-radius, 60-foot-tall cylinder, centred on a point within range When the rain begins, each creature in the area must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 4d6 acid damage on failure or half as much damage on a success For the duration, A creature must also make this saving throw when it enters the spell's area for the first time on its turn or ends its turn there

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the acid damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 3rd.

name: Aegir's Breath
entries: You blow a cloud of frigid air at a creature or object within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 1d10} Cold damage, or {@damage 1d12} if the target is at least partially submerged in water.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Cantrip Upgrade
entries: The spell creates two clouds at level 5, three clouds at level 11, and four clouds at level 17. You can direct the clouds at the same target or at different ones. Make a separate attack roll for each cloud.

name: Ambush Prey

m.text: a broken twig

entries: You channel primal predatory energies to perfectly conceal your presence in order to surprise your target. You become {@condition invisible} for the spell's duration, granting advantage on all Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks to remain hidden. The invisibility will last for the duration of the spell, however, moving 5 feet or more from your position when you cast the spell will end the effect.
As long as you remain invisible, the first attack you make against any target who is unaware of your presence deals an additional {@damage 1d6} points of damage. This attack ends the spell.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot above 2nd level, the damage of your first attack increases by {@scaledamage 1d6|2-9|1d6} for every slot level above 2nd.

affects.special: Any target who is unaware of your presence

name: Ancestral Communion
entries: You invoke the wisdom of your ancestors to gain insight into your trials. When you cast the spell, and at the start of each of your turns for the duration, you gain inspiration if you don't already have it.

name: Ancestral Communion
entries: You invoke the wisdom of your ancestors to gain insight into your trials. When you cast the spell, and at the start of each of your turns for the duration, you gain {@variantrule Heroic Inspiration|XPHB} if you don't already have it.

name: Angrboda's Fury
entries: When you cast this spell, you open yourself up to become a conduit of the rage of the giant goddess {@deity Angrboda|Norse|NorthlandsWorldbook}. One creature within range makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target becomes {@variantrule Vulnerability|XPHB|Vulnerable} to one type of damage of your choice. If the creature has {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the damage type you selected, it loses its {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} and takes damage as normal, but it does not have {@variantrule Vulnerability|XPHB|Vulnerability} to the damage type you chose.
The creature can repeat the Wisdom saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending this spell on a success.

name: Antiballistics Field
entries: A 40-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} extends from you, disrupting projectiles and causing Ranged weapons to malfunction. Within the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}, whenever a Ranged weapon is used for an attack, the weapon immediately malfunctions and the attack is lost. A malfunctioning weapon can't be used to make an attack until a creature takes the {@action Utilize|XPHB} action to fix the weapon malfunction. Ranged attacks using weapons whose projectiles pass through the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} and deal only half damage on a hit.

name: Arboreal Curse
entries: You attempt to turn one creature that you can see within range into wood. If the target's body is made of flesh, the creature must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it is {@condition restrained} as its flesh begins to harden into bark. On a successful save, the creature isn't affected.

A creature {@condition restrained} by this spell must make another Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns. If it successfully saves against this spell three times, the spell ends. If it fails its Constitution saving throw three times, it is turned into a tree and subjected to the {@condition petrified} condition for the duration. The successes and failures don't need to be consecutive; keep track of both until the target collects three of a kind.
If the transformed creature is burned, chopped down, or otherwise destroyed while {@condition petrified}, the creature is slain.

A creature remains transformed unless the effect is reversed within one year with {@spell greater restoration}, {@spell wish}, or similar magical effects. If the creature spends one year and a day as a tree, the transformation becomes permanent, and nothing can return the creature to its original form.

name: Arboreal Curse
entries: You attempt to turn one creature that you can see within range into wood. The creature makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition as its flesh begins to harden into bark. On a successful save, its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is 0 until the start of your next turn.

A creature {@condition Restrained|XPHB} by this spell makes a Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns. If it successfully saves three times, the condition ends. If it fails three times, it is turned into a tree and has the {@condition Petrified|XPHB} condition. The successes and failures needn't be consecutive; keep track of both until the target collects three of a kind.
If the creature is burned, chopped down, or otherwise destroyed while {@condition Petrified|XPHB}, it is killed.

A creature remains transformed unless the effect is reversed within 1 year with {@spell Greater Restoration|XPHB}, {@spell Wish|XPHB}, or similar magic. If the creature spends 1 year and 1 day as a tree, the transformation becomes permanent, and nothing can return the creature to its original form.

name: Arc Blade

m.text: a Melee weapon with which you have proficiency and that is worth 1+ CP

entries: As lightning surges through the weapon used in the spell's casting, you make one attack. This attack can be a melee attack or ranged spell attack using the weapon with a range of 15 feet, as a wave of energy extends from the weapon. The attack uses your spellcasting ability for the attack and damage rolls instead of using Strength or Dexterity. If it is a ranged attack, it deals Lightning damage. Otherwise, it can deal Lightning damage or the weapon's normal damage type (your choice).

entriesHigherLevel.name: Cantrip Upgrade
entries: Whether you deal Lightning damage or the weapon's normal damage type, the attack deals extra Lightning damage when you reach levels 5 ({@dice 1d6}), 11 ({@dice 2d6}), and 17 ({@dice 3d6}).

name: Arcane Aegis
entries: When you cast this spell, you are surrounded by a shimmering light that quickly dissipates. You gain {@dice 2d10} {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}. If a creature hits you with a melee attack before the spell ends, the creature takes Force damage equal to the number of {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} lost as a result of the attack. The spell ends early if you have no {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You gain an additional {@dice 2d10} {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} for each spell slot level above 1.

name: Arcanomagnetic Repulsion
entries: You emit waves of arcanomagnetic energy, distorting the trajectories of ferrous items. For the duration, attacks using ferrous weapons or ammunition made against you have disadvantage In addition, the area within 20 feet of you is difficult terrain for creatures that are made of ferrous metal or are wearing ferrous armour

entries.name: Magnetic Pulse.
entries: When you cast this spell and as a bonus action on your subsequent turns, you can force one Huge or smaller creature that is experiencing this difficult terrain to make a Strength saving throw On a failure, it takes 1d6 force damage is knocked {@condition prone}

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage and radius of the area of difficult terrain increase by 1d6 and 5 feet, respectively, for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Arcanomagnetic Storm
entries: A storm made of crackling lightning and arcanomagnetic winds appears in a location you choose within range The area of the storm consists of up to ten 10foot cubes, which you can arrange as you wish, and which last until the spell ends Each cube must have at least one face adjacent to the face of another cube. As a bonus action at the start of each of your turns, you can remove one 10-foot cube, and place another 10-foot-cube adjacent to the face of another cube.

Each creature that starts its turn in the area or enters the area for the first time on its turn must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 4d8 lightning damage on a failure, or half as much damage on a success Each creature that ends its turn in the area must make a Strength saving throw, taking 4d8 force damage and being knocked {@condition prone} on a failure, or taking half as much damage and not being knocked {@condition prone} on a success A creature made of ferrous metal or wearing ferrous armour has disadvantage on this Strength saving throw
The area is difficult terrain for any creatures made of ferrous metal or wearing ferrous armour

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 8th level or higher, increase the lightning and force damage by 1d8 for each slot level above 7th.

name: Arm Cannon
entries: You fire out the bones of your forearm through your hand, leaving a severe wound that immediately regrows and heals. Make a ranged spell attack against a creature within range. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 4d8} Piercing damage and must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be pushed 15 feet away from you. If pushed into an obstacle, the target is impaled by the bone and has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn. Creatures that are Large or larger have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on this saving throw.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d8} and the pushing distance by 5 feet for each spell slot level above 2.

name: Armament
entries: Up to five {@filter simple or martial weapons|items|type=simple weapon;martial weapon|miscellaneous=mundane;!reprinted} of your choice materialize in an unoccupied space you can see within range. The weapons are nonmagical, but they are well-made and stylistically look however you would like. The weapons vanish when the spell ends.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you can summon three additional simple or martial weapons of your choice for each slot level above 1st.

name: Aspect of the Narwhal
entries: A willing creature that you touch takes on the aspects of a narwhal. It grows flippers and a long horn-like tusk. The target gains {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB|Resistance} to Cold damage while submerged in water, its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} becomes 5 feet, and it gains a {@variantrule Swim Speed|XPHB} of 50 feet. The target can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on any turn in which it moves at least 15 feet directly toward an enemy to make a gore attack that deals Piercing damage equal to {@damage 2d6} plus its Strength modifier.

name: Assisted Aim
entries: You invigorate up to three creatures within range with improved accuracy. Each target gains a +1 bonus to attack rolls it makes with Ranged weapons. Additionally, the normal and long range of Ranged weapons wielded by a target are doubled for the spell's duration.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 1.

name: Astral Flood

components.m: a mixture of water and powdered silver

entries: You channel energy from the Astral Sea to unleash a torrent of magic from you in a 30-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. Each creature in the {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone} makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 4d10} Cold or Radiant damage (chosen when you cast this spell) on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. On a failed save, a target also suffers an additional effect determined by your choice of damage type:

items.name: Cold Damage
entries: The target has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on the next {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB} it makes before the end of your next turn.

items.name: Radiant Damage
entries: The target has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} condition until the end of your next turn.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d10} for each spell slot level above 3.

name: At Your Side
entries: You and up to three other willing creatures of your choice within range form an arcane bond, which magically pulls you forward when moving towards each other. For the duration, each target's speed increases by 5 feet, and whenever an affected creature ends its turn, other targets of the spell can use their reaction to move up to half their speed in the direction of another affected creature.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Aundair's Silent Sanctum
entries: You surround yourself with an invisible bubble of energy in a 5-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}. The sphere muffles sound in both directions. Creatures outside of the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) checks made to hear any sounds from within the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}, and creatures inside the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) checks made to hear sounds outside of the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}.

In addition, creatures have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against effects that require them to hear a sound from the other side of the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}, such as the {@spell Command|XPHB} spell.

name: Aura of Desecration
entries: Life-defiling energy radiates from you in an aura with a 30-foot radius. Until the spell ends, the aura moves with you, centered on you. Whenever creatures of your choice enter the area for the first time on a turn or start their turn there, they must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 4d6} necrotic damage and can't regain hit points until the start of their next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and suffers no other effect.

name: Aura of Impurity
entries: Enervating energy radiates from you in an aura with a 30-foot radius Until the spell ends, the aura moves with you, centred on you Each creature of your choice that enters the aura for the first time on its turn or starts its turn there must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or become drained until the end of its next turn While drained, a creature must roll a d4 and subtract the number rolled from each ability check, attack roll, or saving throw it makes, and any hit points a creature regains are reduced by half

name: Awaken Ship Guardian
entries: You summon a protective spirit to live within the hull of a Large or larger ship. While the spell lasts, the ship has the following benefits:

items: {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Fire damage.

Each time the ship takes damage from a Large or larger creature, the attacking creature makes a Wisdom saving throw, taking {@damage 5d6} Psychic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} while you are on the ship, you can expend a spell slot, and the ship regains {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to three times the slot level plus your spellcasting modifier.

name: Ballistic Smite

time.condition: which you take immediately after hitting a creature with a Ranged weapon

entries: Choose Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison, or Thunder damage. The target hit by the attack takes an extra {@damage 2d6} damage of the chosen type. The triggering attack can deal the chosen damage type or its normal damage type (your choice).

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d6} for each spell slot level above 1.

name: Bearstormer
entries: You create three phantasmal grizzly bears in a 20-foot {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube} within range. Until the spell ends, you can use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to move the {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube} up to 40 feet.

When the {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube} appears, each enemy in it makes an Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 4d8} Psychic damage and has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only. A creature also makes this save when the spell's area moves into its space and when a creature enters the spell's area or ends its turn there. A creature makes this save only once per turn.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You increase the size of the {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube} by 20-feet, the number of phantasmal bears by two, and the damage by {@dice 2d8} for each spell slot level above 5th.

name: Beast of Ragnarok

components.m: a bezoar formed in a wolf's stomach

entries: The spectral aura of {@deity Fenris|Norse|NorthlandsWorldbook} surrounds you as you draw Ragnarok to the world for a moment. Until the spell ends, the sky grows dark, casting the world in {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} in a 1-mile {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on you. Thick snows fall inside the {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere}, causing the ground to become {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB} and vision to be {@variantrule Heavily Obscured|XPHB}.
You gain the following benefits for the Duration:

items: You see clearly within the {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} and are unaffected by the {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB} caused by the spell.
You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on all {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB|d20 Tests}.
All creatures have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against you.

You have {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to all types of damage except for one. Roll a {@condition d12} to randomly determine a damage type (1. Acid, 2. Bludgeoning, 3. Fire, 4. Force, 5. Lightning, 6. Necrotic, 7. Piercing, 8. Poison, 9. Psychic, 10. Radiant, 11. Slashing, or 12. Thunder.) You have {@variantrule Vulnerability|XPHB|Vulnerability} to the damage type you roll.
You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws to resist or end all conditions.

name: Beast Transmutation
entries: This spell transforms a beast that you can see within range into a new humanoid form. An unwilling creature must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw to avoid the effect. The spell has no effect on a beast with 0 hit points.

The transformation lasts for the duration, or until the target drops to 0 hit points or dies. The new form has the appearance of a humanoid of any race you choose. The target's game statistics, excluding mental ability scores, are replaced by the statistics of a {@creature commoner}. It retains its alignment and personality.

The target assumes the hit points of its commoner form. When it reverts to its normal form, the beast returns to the number of hit points it had before it transformed. If it reverts as a result of dropping to 0 hit points, any excess damage carries over to its normal form. As long as the excess damage doesn't reduce the beast's normal form to 0 hit points, it isn't knocked {@condition unconscious}.
The creature is limited in the actions it can perform by the nature of its new form.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the spell's duration increases by 1 hour for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Become Nightwing
entries: This spell imbues you with wings of shadow. For the duration of the spell, you gain a flying speed of 60 feet and a new attack action: Nightwing Breath.

entries.name: Nightwing Breath (Recharge 4-6)
entries: You exhale shadow‑substance in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in the area takes {@damage 5d6} necrotic damage, or half the damage with a successful Dexterity saving throw.

name: Bergelmir's Provocation

time.condition: which you take when you see a creature make an attack or spell attack

entries: The creature making the attack must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, the creature makes the attack against a different eligible target of your choice, which cannot include the creature itself. If there is no other eligible target, the creature's attack is wasted.

name: Beseech the Norns

m.text: a silver spindle worth 100+ GP, which the spell consumes

entries: You contact one of the three {@deity The Norns|Norse|NorthlandsWorldbook|Norns}, the weavers of fate, to intercede on your behalf by altering the past, present, or future. Choose one of the following effects:

items.name: Change the Past (Uror)
entries: Choose a creature you can see that died since the start of your last turn. That creature is returned to life with 1 {@variantrule Hit Point|XPHB}. This spell can't revive any creature that has died of old age, nor does it restore any missing body parts.

items.name: Guide the Present (Verthandi)
entries: Treat the first attack roll or ability check you roll before the end of your turn as a natural 20.

items.name: Shape the Future (Skuld)
entries: Beginning at the start of your next turn and lasting for 1 minute, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on all ability checks and saving throws.

If you cast the spell more than once before finishing a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, there is a cumulative 25 percent chance for each casting after the first that the spell has no effect (other than to consume the material component).

name: Billowing Sails
entries: You touch a ship or other wind-powered vehicle and fill its sails with a strong breeze. Whenever the ship travels by sail, its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} increases by 10 ft. or by 1 mph.

name: Binding Pledge

components.m: a book of religious or legal importance

entries: When you cast the spell, a willing creature within range makes a promise, swears an oath, or enters into a contract. For the duration of the spell, you immediately know if the creature breaks that promise, oath, or contract. If this happens, for the remainder of the duration of the spell, you know the distance and direction to the creature. If this spell is dispelled, you immediately know it but don't learn the distance and direction to the creature.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The duration becomes 30 days (level 3-4 slot) or 1 year (level 5-6 slot). If you use a level 7+ spell slot, the spell lasts until dispelled.

name: Bitter Wind
entries: Freezing wind, forming a line 120 feet long and 20 feet wide, blasts from you in a direction you choose for the spell's duration. Each creature that starts its turn in the line must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be pushed 30 feet away from you in a direction following the line. Creatures that fail the saving throw also take {@damage 1d12} cold damage and are knocked {@condition prone}. If cast during cold weather or in dark or shadowy conditions, the saving throw is made with disadvantage. Any creature in the line must spend 2 feet of movement for every 1 foot it moves when moving closer to you.
As a bonus action on each of your turns before the spell ends, you can change the direction in which the line blasts from you.
The bitter wind disperses gas or vapor, and it extinguishes candles, torches, lanterns, and similar flames in the area.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the saving throw is made with disadvantage, and the damage increases by {@dice 1d12} for each slot level above 3rd.

name: Black Hand
entries: You gather the powers of darkness into your fist and fling dark, paralyzing flame. Make a ranged spell attack against a target you can see within 30 feet of you. On a successful hit, you have advantage on attack rolls against the target and the target has disadvantage on attack rolls, Constitution-based ability checks, and Constitution saving throws for the duration of the spell. At the end of each of its turns, an affected target can make another Constitution saving throw. On a success, the spell ends on the target.

name: Black Ribbons
entries: Centered on a point you can see within range, you pull pieces of the Plane of Shadow into your own reality, causing a 20-foot cube to fill with inky ribbons that turn the area into difficult terrain and wrap around nearby creatures. Any creature that ends its turn in the area becomes {@condition restrained} by the ribbons until the end of its next turn, unless it makes a successful Dexterity saving throw. Once a creature succeeds on this saving throw, it can't be {@condition restrained} again by the ribbons, but it's still affected by the difficult terrain.

name: Black Well
entries: You summon a seething sphere of dark energy 5 feet in diameter at a point within range. The sphere pulls creatures toward it and devours the life force of those it envelops. Every creature other than you that starts its turn within 90 feet of the black well must make a successful Strength saving throw or be pulled 50 feet toward the well. A creature pulled into the well takes {@damage 6d8} necrotic damage and is {@condition stunned}; a successful Constitution saving throw halves the damage and causes the creature to become {@condition incapacitated}. A creature that starts its turn inside the well also makes a Constitution saving throw; the creature is {@condition stunned} on a failed save or {@condition incapacitated} on a success. An {@condition incapacitated} creature that leaves the well recovers immediately and can take actions and reactions on that turn.

A creature takes damage only upon entering the well—it takes no additional damage for remaining there—but if it leaves the well and is pulled back in again, it takes damage again. A total of nine Medium creatures, three Large creatures, or one Huge creature can be inside the well's other-dimensional space at one time. When the spell's duration ends, all creatures inside it tumble out in a heap, landing {@condition prone}.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, the damage dealt by the well increases by {@dice 1d8}—and the well pulls creatures an additional 5 feet—for each slot level above 6th.

name: Blade of Blood and Bone

m.text: a dagger or short sword, which is not consumed in the casting

entries: When you cast this spell, you cut your body with the material component, your hit point maximum decreases by 3 and the material component disappears. For the duration, you can use a bonus action to draw a blade made of your own bone, blood, and sinew from your body. The blade is a magical weapon, uses your spell attack bonus when you attack with it, and deals {@damage 1d6} slashing damage on a hit. You are considered proficient with the blade. As a bonus action, you can slide the blade back into your body to conceal it. When the duration ends, the incision in your body disappears, your hit point maximum is restored, and the material component reappears.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd-level or higher, the damage dealt by the blade increases by {@dice 1d6} for every two slot levels above 2nd, and your hit point maximum decreases by an additional amount equal to the level of the slot used.

name: Blind Ambush
entries: You blow on a whistle, releasing an inaudible sound. Choose a point on the ground within range. The first time a creature moves 5 feet of more while within a 10-foot Square centered on that point before the spell ends, an eldritch maw immediately erupts from beneath the ground, dealing {@damage 2d10} Piercing damage to each creature within the Square and knocking one of them {@condition Prone|XPHB} (decide when the spell triggers). The spell then ends.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d10} for each spell slot level above 2. If you use a level 5+ spell slot, the spell can trigger a second time before it ends.

name: Blinding Radiance
entries: Bright light erupts from your form and dazzles those around you For the duration, you emit bright light in a 50-foot radius and dim light for an additional 50 feet Each creature that moves within 10 feet of you for the first time on its turn or that starts its turn there must make a Constitution saving throw On a failure, a creature takes 3d10 radiant damage and is {@condition blinded} until the start of its next turn On a success, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't {@condition blinded}

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d10 for each slot level above 4th.

name: Bloat
entries: You cause the gases within a creature you can see within range to expand rapidly. The target makes a Constitution saving throw, taking {@damage 3d10} Necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. If the damage that the creature takes equals or exceeds its Constitution ability score, the creature floats vertically 5 feet and remains suspended until the start of your next turn. The target can move only by pushing or pulling against a fixed object or surface within reach (such as a wall or a ceiling), which allows it to move as if it were climbing. When the spell ends, the target floats gently to the ground.

name: Blood Bolt
entries: You hurl a twisting bolt of blood at a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 1d6} necrotic damage, and you gain a number of temporary hit points equal to your proficiency bonus.
The spell's damage increases by {@dice 1d6} when you reach 5th level ({@dice 2d6}), 11th level ({@dice 3d6}), and 17th level ({@dice 4d6}).

entriesHigherLevel.name: Cantrip Upgrade
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d6} when you reach levels 5 ({@dice 2d6}), 11 ({@dice 3d6}), and 17 ({@dice 4d6}).

name: Blood Bolt
entries: You hurl a twisting bolt of blood at a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 1d6} Necrotic damage, and you gain a number of {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Cantrip Upgrade
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d6} when you reach levels 5 ({@dice 2d6}), 11 ({@dice 3d6}), and 17 ({@dice 4d6}).

name: Blood Bond

components.m: a rag soaked in your own blood

entries: As part of casting this spell, you must expend three {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB} or the spell automatically fails. Roll the expended {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB}, and the target gains a number of {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the roll's total.

For the duration, you know the direction and distance to the target, and you and the target can speak telepathically. Additionally, you can target that creature when you cast a spell with a range of Self or Touch, regardless of the distance between you. These benefits are suppressed while you and the creature are not on the same plane.

At any point, the targeted creature can choose to end the spell early. If it does, the creature loses all remaining {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} granted by this spell and takes Necrotic damage equal to the {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} lost.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The duration increases with a spell slot level 5 or 6 (8 hours), 7 or 8 (24 hours), and 9 (7 days).

name: Blood Rush
entries: As part of casting this spell, you must expend one {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB|Hit Point Die} or the spell automatically fails. Roll the {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB|Hit Point Die} twice, and regain a number of {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the added roll plus your spellcasting ability modifier.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can expend one additional {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB|Hit Point Die} for each spell slot level above 1.

name: Blood Sacrifice

components.m: a drop of your own blood

entries: You sacrifice a portion of your life force to enhance your magical power. When you cast this spell, you take {@damage 1d6} necrotic damage, which can't be reduced or prevented in any way. For the duration, when you cast a spell that deals damage, one target of the spell (your choice) takes an extra {@damage 1d6} damage of the same type as the spell's normal damage type (your choice if there are multiple).

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage you take and the extra damage your spells deal both increase by {@dice 1d6} for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Blood Sacrifice

components.m: a drop of your own blood

entries: You sacrifice a portion of your life force to enhance your magical power. When you cast this spell, you take {@damage 1d6} Necrotic damage, which can't be reduced or prevented in any way. For the duration, when you cast a spell that deals damage, one target of the spell (your choice) takes an extra {@damage 1d6} damage of the same type as the spell's normal damage type (your choice if there are multiple).

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage you take and the extra damage your spells deal both increase by {@dice 1d6} for each spell slot level above 2.

name: Blood Tide
entries: As part of casting this spell, you must expend six {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB} or the spell automatically fails.

A gout of blood forming a 100-foot-long, 10-foot-wide {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line} blasts out from you in a direction you choose. Each creature in the {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line} must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is pushed 100 feet away from you in a direction following the {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line}, has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition, and takes Bludgeoning damage equal to a roll of the {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB} expended on the spell plus your spellcasting ability modifier. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage only.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can expend one additional {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB|Hit Point Die} for each spell slot level above 6.

name: Blood Wisp

m.text: a ruby worth 10 GP

entries: As part of casting this spell, you must expend two {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB} or the spell automatically fails. Roll the {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB} expended to cast the spell and create a red wisp with a number of {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the roll plus your spellcasting ability modifier. The wisp circles your head. It has an AC equal to 10 plus your spellcasting ability modifier, and uses your saving throws.

Each time you roll damage for a spell while the wisp circles you, you can reroll one of the damage dice. You must use the new roll, and the wisp takes damage equal to the new roll. If the wisp is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, the spell ends.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can expend one additional {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB|Hit Point Die} for each spell slot level above 2.

name: Bloodbane Rune
entries: As part of casting this spell, you must expend one {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB|Hit Point Die} or the spell automatically fails. You target a weapon of your choice within range and scrawl onto it a rune written in blood.

For the duration, while you wield this weapon, it weeps a phantasmal red ichor when within 30 feet of an Undead creature. Additionally, once per turn, when you damage an Undead creature with the weapon, you deal extra Radiant damage. To determine this damage, roll the number of {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB} you expended to cast the spell.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You expend an additional {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB|Hit Point Die} for each spell slot level above 1. In addition, your {@status Concentration|XPHB} can last longer with a spell slot of level 2 (up to 10 minutes) or 3+ (up to 1 hour).

name: Bloodletter
entries: You touch a nonmagical weapon. Until the spell ends, the first creature hit by the weapon must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or receive a festering wound. A creature with a festering wound takes {@damage 2d6} Necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns for the spell's duration. A creature can only have one festering wound at a time.
If the creature receives healing, the spell and recurring damage end.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d6} for each spell slot above 2.

name: Bloodletter
entries: You touch a nonmagical weapon. Until the spell ends, the next creature hit by the weapon must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or receive a festering wound. A creature with a festering wound takes {@damage 2d6} necrotic damage at the beginning of its turn for the remainder of the spell's duration. A creature can only have one festering wound at a time.
Receiving at least 1 point of magical healing closes a festering wound, ending the recurring damage and the spell.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you can increase the damage dealt by a festering wound by {@dice 1d6} for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Blunder

time.condition: which you take when a creature you can see within range hits a target with an attack roll

entries: The attacker must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or suffer one of the following effects of your choice:

entries.name: Fumble
entries: The target drops one object of your choice that it's holding, with the object landing in a space you choose up to 10 feet away from the target. If the target drops the weapon it is using for the attack roll, it can make an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} for the triggering attack.

entries.name: Prat Fall
entries: The target has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. The {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} from the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition applies against the triggering attack, potentially causing it to miss.

name: Body Warping of Gorgoroth
entries: Choose a Humanoid of your size that you can see. You physically transform to become an exact duplicate of that creature for the duration. Even a thorough physical examination fails to find any differences between you and the target.
Your voice and equipment don't change.

name: Boil Blood
entries: As part of casting this spell, you must expend one {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB|Hit Point Die} or the spell automatically fails. A willing target takes Fire damage equal to a roll of the expended {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB|Hit Point Die}. If the target has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition, that condition immediately ends.

name: Bone Cage

m.text: the bones of at least one non-animated corpse, which the spell consumes

entries: You draw the bones from all corpses within range, forming a carapace of ribcages and femurs. You gain temporary hit points for each Small or larger corpse wholly or partly within range, according to its size, that last for the duration:

As an action on a subsequent turn, you can cause your armour of bones to erupt, expending all remaining temporary hit points. Each other creature within range must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking piercing damage equal to your expended temporary hit points on a failure, or half as much damage on a success. Whatever the manner in which the temporary hit points are lost, the bones shatter and can't be used in this way again.
entriesHigherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the radius of this spell increases by 10 feet for each slot level above 5th.

name: Bone-Chilling Smite

time.condition: which you take immediately after hitting a creature with a melee weapon or an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}

entries: The target takes an extra {@damage 3d8} Necrotic damage from the attack, and it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or gain one level of {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} until the spell ends.

At the end of each of its turns, the {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB|Exhausted} target repeats the save. On a success, it removes all {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} caused by this spell. On a failure, it receives one level of {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB}.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d8} for each spell slot level above 3rd.

name: Bound Fortunes

components.m: two small spindles bound together with thread

entries: You touch another willing creature and bind your fates together until the spell ends. For the duration, if the target is within 60 feet of you and makes an ability check, attack roll, or saving throw, you may use your {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to allow the target to reroll and use the new result. The target can do the same to you. Each time you do this, your, and only your {@variantrule Hit Point|XPHB} maximum is reduced by {@dice 1d4}, and the same is true of the target. If this reduces your {@variantrule Hit Point|XPHB} maximum to 0, you die. This reduction is removed when the spell ends.

name: Bragi's Theatrical Fall

time.condition: which you take when an attack would reduce you to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} but not kill you outright

entries: With a gasp and loud proclamation, you seem to fall dead to the ground. Instead of being reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, you are reduced to a number of {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to your spellcasting ability modifier. At the same time, you have the {@condition Invisible|XPHB} condition, and an illusion of your dead body appears, lying in the space where your body would have fallen.

If a creature takes the {@action Study|XPHB} action to examine your illusory body, the creature can determine it is an illusion with a successful Intelligence ({@skill Investigation|XPHB}) check against your spell save DC. If a creature discerns the illusion for what it is, the illusion becomes faint to the creature.

The {@condition Invisible|XPHB} condition ends if you take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action, use the {@action Magic|XPHB} action to cast a spell that lets a creature regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, or use any action to cause harm to a creature.

name: Branch and Root of Yggdrasil

components.m: branch, leaf, or bark from a World Tree

entries: All trees are intrinsically linked to Yggdrasil. When you cast this spell and touch a tree, you and up to eight willing creatures in contact with that tree are transported to a random location on Yggdrasil. If you are touching a World Tree found on the mortal plane (such as those found in the Northlands) when you cast the spell, you can specify a target destination on Yggdrasil in general terms, and you appear in or near that destination, as determined by the GM.

Using this magic requires a sacrifice from the caster. After casting this spell, your {@variantrule Hit Point|XPHB} maximum is reduced by an amount equal to a roll of one of your {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB|Hit Dice} until you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Breath of the Deep
entries: You conjure sea water from the deepest trench to surround a creature that you can see within range. The water seeps into the target's mouth and around its body, slowly crushing it with the unfathomable weight of the sea. The target takes {@damage 3d6} Bludgeoning damage and is unable to talk for the duration or use the verbal components of spells.

name: Bright Sparks
entries: Sparks fly from your fingers for a moment, generating bright blue light. This illuminates the region around you to a distance of 60 feet until the start of your next turn. Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks have advantage to spot creatures hidden in shadows.

name: Brittle Bone Throw
entries: You hurl a splintered bone fragment at a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 1d8} Piercing damage. On a miss, you can shatter the bone mid-air and redirect the remnant towards another creature within 15 feet of the original target. Make another ranged spell attack. On a hit, the new target takes {@damage 1d4} Piercing damage.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Cantrip Upgrade
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d8} and {@dice 1d4}, respectively, when you reach levels 5 ({@damage 2d8}, {@damage 2d4}), 11 ({@damage 3d8}, {@damage 3d4}), and 17 ({@damage 4d8}, {@damage 4d4}).

name: Bubble Lift
entries: You blow a bubble around any solid, granular, or liquid object that weighs 500 pounds or less, causing it to float 4 feet off the ground. No matter what the contents of the bubble are, the bubble weighs 10 pounds and can be pushed using an action. Strong winds or effects that would push a creature also push the bubble. The bubble always floats at least 4 feet off the ground, and descends from a fall at a speed of 10 feet per round.
As an action, a creature can pierce the outside of the bubble, causing it to pop and releasing its contents.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you can increase the weight the bubble can lift by 500 pounds for each slot level above 1st.

name: Buried Alive
entries: You send your enemies to their graves even if they aren't dead yet. A creature that you can see within range that is standing on the ground must make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the ground opens and swallows the target, burying it up to 10 feet deep. While buried, the target has {@quickref Cover||3||total cover}, has the {@condition restrained} and {@condition blinded} conditions, and can't breathe. On a successful save, the target is knocked {@condition prone}, and its speed is reduced to 0 until the end of its next turn. A buried creature can dig out of the grave by using its action to make a DC 15 Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. On a success, it digs 5 feet closer to the surface. If it succeeds by 5 or more, it reaches the surface. When the creature reaches the surface, it exits the ground {@condition prone}.
The target automatically succeeds on its saving throw if it's standing on any thickness of stone or metal, or at least 2 inches of wood.

name: Buried Alive
entries: You send your enemies to their graves even if they aren't dead yet. A creature that you can see within range that is standing on the ground must make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the ground opens and swallows the target, burying it up to 10 feet deep. While buried, the target has {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Total Cover}, has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} and {@condition Blinded|XPHB} conditions, and can't breathe. On a successful save, the target has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition, and its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is 0 until the end of its next turn. A buried creature can dig out of the grave by using its action to make a DC 15 Strength ({@skill Athletics|XPHB}) check. On a success, it digs 5 feet closer to the surface. If it succeeds by 5 or more, it reaches the surface. When the creature reaches the surface, it exits the ground with the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.
The target automatically succeeds on its saving throw if it's standing on any thickness of stone or metal, or at least 2 inches of wood.

name: Burning Blade

m.text: a Melee weapon with which you have proficiency and that is worth 1+ CP

entries: Encasing the weapon used in the spell's casting in flames, you make one melee attack. The attack uses your spellcasting ability for the attack and damage rolls instead of using Strength or Dexterity. If the attack deals damage, it can be Fire damage or the weapon's normal damage type (your choice). If the weapon's damage die or any of the spell's damage dice roll the highest number, you can roll that die again and add it to the damage, rolling again if it is the highest number, and so on. You can add a maximum number of dice to the damage roll equal to your spellcasting ability modifier.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Cantrip Upgrade
entries: Whether you deal Fire damage or the weapon's normal damage type, the attack deals extra Fire damage when you reach levels 5 ({@dice 1d6}), 11 ({@dice 2d6}), and 17 ({@dice 3d6}).

name: Burning Radiance
entries: A line of light 60 feet long and 5 feet wide emanates from you in a direction of your choice. Each creature in the line must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 10d8} radiant damage and catches fire; until someone takes an action to douse the fire, the creature takes {@damage 1d10} fire damage at the start of each of its turns. A successful saving throw halves the damage and prevents a creature from catching fire.
The burning radiance ignites flammable objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried.

name: Burst Forth
entries: As part of casting this spell, you must expend seven {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB} or the spell automatically fails. You teleport inside a creature that you can see within range and burst forth from it in a fountain of gore in the nearest unoccupied space. The target makes a Constitution saving throw, taking Necrotic damage equal to a roll of the {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB} expended to cast the spell plus your spellcasting ability modifier on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can expend one additional {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB|Hit Point Die} for each spell slot level above 7.

name: Butterfly Storm
entries: You create a chaotic cloud of butterflies in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point you choose within range. The area is heavily obscured, and resting smoke or fog in the area is dispersed.

Creatures of your choice in the area when you cast this spell ignore the following effects. For the duration, the affected area is {@quickref difficult terrain||3}. When a creature attempts to leave the spell's area, it must make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, it is pulled back to an unoccupied space closest to the center of the sphere.

name: Buzzing Bee
entries: You call forth a noisy spectral bee. You target a creature that you can see within range. The bee hovers around the target, distracting it with loud buzzing. For the duration, the target has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) checks, Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|XPHB}) checks, and Constitution saving throws made to maintain {@status Concentration|XPHB}. In addition, the target cannot benefit from the {@condition Invisible|XPHB} condition.
The bee moves with the target, hovering within 3 feet of it as long as the target is within 120 feet of you. The bee disappears when the spell ends or if the target moves out of range.

name: Calcified Memories
entries: You touch the bones of a deceased creature. When you do so, a ghostly grey illusion of the fallen creature appears above its corpse to reenact the last 6 seconds of its life. The illusion only shows the creature's actions, such as reacting to an unseen monster or choking from poisonous gas, but does not show the monster or effect causing the behavior, only their outline. This spell has no effect on Undead creatures. Once a corpse's death has been revealed in this way, it can't be shown again for 24 hours.

name: Call Deity
entries: You can cast this spell only during the duration of a Contact Deity spell you also cast. You cause the deity you contacted to manifest in the nearest unoccupied space. For 1 hour, it acts as it wishes but treats you as an ally if you don't take actions against it. It doesn't extend this courtesy to your allies and interprets your attempts to protect others as acting against it.

name: Call of the Wild

components.m: a bit of animal fur or hide

entries: You unleash a primal howl that calls lesser creatures to your command. Each Beast in a 100-foot sphere centered on you when you cast the spell must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a target is {@condition charmed} by you, it can understand your commands, and it follows them on its next turn to the best of its ability. On your subsequent turns, you can take an action to issue a new command. On a successful save, a target is {@condition charmed} by you until the start of your next turn, but you have no additional ability to command it. The howl is audible within 300 feet.

name: Call of the Wild

components.m: a bit of animal fur or hide

entries: You unleash a primal howl that calls lesser creatures to your command. Each Beast in a 100-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from you when you cast the spell must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a target has the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition, it can understand your commands, and it follows them on its next turn to the best of its ability. On your subsequent turns, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to issue a new command. On a successful save, a target has the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition until the start of your next turn, but you have no additional ability to command it. The howl is audible within 300 feet.

name: Call Shadow Mastiff
entries: You tap into the power of the Plane of Shadow and conjure a large dog made of pure shadow in an unoccupied space you can see within range. The shadow mastiff disappears when it drops to 0 hit points or when the spell ends.

The mastiff is friendly to you and your companions. Roll initiative for the mastiff, which has its own turns. It obeys verbal commands that you issue to it (no action required by you). If you don't issue any commands to it, the mastiff defends itself from hostile creatures, but otherwise takes no actions.

The GM has the shadow mastiff's statistics, using a {@creature dire wolf}, except it is a Monstrosity, it doubles its proficiency bonus when making Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks, and it has the Bay action and the Shadow {@skill Stealth} bonus action, both of which are described below:

entries.name: Bay
entries: The shadow mastiff uses an action to release a terrifying howl. Each creature within a 30-foot cone of the mastiff must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition frightened} for 1 minute. While {@condition frightened}, a creature must take the {@action Dash} action and move away from the mastiff by the safest available route on each of its turns, unless there is nowhere to move. A {@condition frightened} creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the Bay of shadow mastiffs for the next 24 hours.

entries.name: Shadow Stealth
entries: As a bonus action while in dim light or darkness, the mastiff takes the {@action Hide} action.

name: Call the Rabid Beast

components.m: a fang from a rabid animal

entries: A creature you touch transforms into a rabid monster, filled with primal fury. The target sprouts thick fur and its mouth elongates into a fanged maw. It gains 20 {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}. While transformed, the creature has the following effects:

items: It has an {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB} of 17 if its AC is lower than that.
It has a +5 bonus on damage rolls with Strength based attacks.
It can make a Bite attack as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. The Bite deals {@damage 1d6} + its Strength modifier Slashing damage.
It has {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition.
It can't cast spells or maintain {@status Concentration|XPHB}.

At the start of each of its turns, it must succeed on a DC 10 Wisdom saving throw or lose control until the spell ends. A creature that loses control must take an {@action Attack|XPHB} action on each of its turns, using melee attacks against the nearest creature. If none are within reach, the creature must use its movement, and if necessary the {@action Dash|XPHB} action, to move toward the nearest creature.

name: Call to Action

time.condition: which you take in response to another creature's turn starting

entries: The creature starting its turn may immediately use its {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to take the {@action Dash|XPHB}, {@action Disengage|XPHB}, {@action Dodge|XPHB}, or {@action Help|XPHB} action.

name: Calling Card

components.m: a stamp carved like the mark left by your calling card

entries: You touch a corpse and leave a magical mark. You can choose to make it a visible mark that appears as a rune or word written on the flesh, or you can choose to make the mark {@condition Invisible|XPHB}. A creature that takes the {@action Study|XPHB} action to specifically examine a corpse automatically detects it, whether visible or {@condition Invisible|XPHB}.

name: Can't Trip
entries: Choose a willing creature within range that you can see Until the end of your next turn, that creature is immune to the {@condition prone} condition If it is already {@condition prone} and is not {@condition restrained}, this spell sets it on its feet
The number of creatures you can simultaneously target with this spell increases by 1 when you reach 5th level (2 creatures), 11th level (3 creatures), and 17th level (4 creatures).

name: Can'trip
entries: You temporarily tangle the Weave around a creature within range that you can see Until the start of your next turn, each time the creature tries to cast a cantrip whilst this spell affects it, it must succeed on a spellcasting ability check against your spell save DC waste its action (but not its spell slot). The spell ends if the target moves out of the spell's range
The maximum level of spell inhibited by this cantrip increases when you reach 5th level (1st-level spells), 11th level (2nd-level spells), and 17th level (3rd-level spells).

name: Candy Blast
entries: You summon a handful of hard candy—boiled sweets, mints, jelly beans, etc.—and hurl them at a creature you can see within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 1d8} Force damage and the candy forms a pile on the ground in its space, causing a 5-foot-square area of your choice in the target's space to become {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}. The candy produced by this spell is edible but has no nutritional value, and vanishes after 1 minute, ending any {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Cantrip Upgrade
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d8} when you reach levels 5 ({@dice 2d8}), 11 ({@dice 3d8}), and 17 ({@dice 4d8}).

name: Cannotrip
entries: Choose a creature you can see within range Each time the target tries to cast a spell of equal or lower level than this spell, it must succeed on a spellcasting ability check against your spell save DC or waste its action (but not its spell slot).

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you inhibit spells 1 spell level higher for each slot level above 1st.

name: Captivate Undead
entries: You usurp the negative energy animating an Undead creature that you can see within range, attempting to take control of it. The target must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, for the duration, the target is {@condition charmed} by you (ignoring any immunity to that condition), and it is friendly toward you. On a successful save, the target has disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes against you before the start of your next turn. If you or any of your allies damage the target or force it to make a saving throw, the spell ends.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 1st.

name: Captivate Undead
entries: You usurp the negative energy animating an Undead creature that you can see within range, attempting to take control of it. The target must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, for the duration, the target has the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition (ignoring any {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to that condition), and it is {@variantrule Friendly [Attitude]|XPHB|Friendly} toward you. On a successful save, the target has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on the next attack roll it makes against you before the start of your next turn. If you or any of your allies damage the target or force it to make a saving throw, the spell ends.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 1.

name: Cat's Spring
entries: You jump up to 10 feet to an unoccupied space you can see and deliver a spectral claw attack that deals Slashing or Force damage (you choose when you cast the spell). Make a melee spell attack against a target. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 1d8} damage of the chosen type, and the next attack roll you make against it before the end of your next turn has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d8} when you reach levels 5 ({@dice 2d8}), 11 (38), and 17 ({@dice 4d8}).

name: Chain of Conviction
entries: You hurl a spectral, barbed chain at a creature that you can see within range. The target makes a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes {@damage 2d6} force damage, is pulled up to 30 feet toward you, and is bound by the chain. While bound by the chain, the creature is tethered to you and can't move or teleport to a space more than 30 feet away from you, and you have advantage on attack rolls made against the creature.

On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage only. The bound target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the spell on itself on a success. If you are ever more than 30 feet away from the target, the spell ends.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by {@dice 1d6} for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Chain of Conviction
entries: You hurl a spectral, barbed chain at a creature that you can see within range. The target makes a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes {@damage 2d6} Force damage, is pulled up to 30 feet toward you, and is bound by the chain. While bound by the chain, the creature is tethered to you and can't move or teleport to a space more than 30 feet away from you, and you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls made against the creature.

On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage only. The bound target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the spell on itself on a success. If you are ever more than 30 feet away from the target, the spell ends.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d6} for each spell slot level above 2.

name: Chains of Beleth
entries: Barbed chains ending in meat hooks burst from the ground from a point you can see within range, flailing in a 20-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on that point.
Each creature in the area makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, it takes {@damage 8d6} Piercing damage and has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition until the spell ends.

The first time a creature enters the chain's area on a turn or starts its turn there, it must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or have the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition while in the area or until it breaks free. A creature {@condition Restrained|XPHB} by the chains can take an action to make a Strength ({@skill Athletics|XPHB}) check against your spell save DC. If it succeeds, it is no longer {@condition Restrained|XPHB}.
When a creature {@condition Restrained|XPHB} by this spell ends its turn, the creature takes {@damage 3d6} Bludgeoning damage.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The initial and subsequent damage increase by {@dice 1d6} for each spell slot level above 6.

name: Chameleon Skin
entries: You imbue a creature you touch with pigment so that its skin, and anything it wears or carries, slowly shifts hues to match its surroundings For the duration, the target can take the Hide action as a bonus action on each of its turns, even when only lightly obscured

If the target did not move during its last turn, creatures have disadvantage on any Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks made to see the target Creatures who do not rely on sight, such as those with tremorsense, are immune to this effect.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 1st.

name: Chant of Thoth
entries: The first time you fail an Intelligence check during the spell's duration, you may automatically succeed on the check if the DC is less than your spell save DC. Otherwise, you gain a +2 bonus to that check. Once you use this benefit, you cannot use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB}.

name: Charnel Banquet
entries: You transform a field of carrion into an empowering feast. For the duration, all creatures of your choice can consume the decaying flesh of any creature. If a creature has eaten of the carrion for the duration, it recovers {@dice 10d6} hit points, recovers half its expended Hit Dice (minimum 1), removes half its levels of {@condition exhaustion} (minimum 1), and gains all the benefits of finishing a short rest.
Creatures affected by this spell must succeed on a Constitution saving throw at the end of the duration or be {@condition poisoned} for 1 hour.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: If this spell is cast using a 9th‑level slot, the affected creatures remove all levels of {@condition exhaustion} gained and recover all expended Hit Dice in addition to the effects noted above.

name: Cheat
entries: You twist your fingers and fate seems to follow suit. Until the end of your next turn, you can reroll any ability check you make to play nonmagical games of skill and must use the new roll. Therefore, this spell could influence a game of poker, but not the result of a {@item Deck of Many Things|XDMG}.

name: Child of Light and Darkness

components.m: a pebble from the Shadow Realm that has been left in the sun

entries: Roll a {@dice d20} at the end of each of your turns for the duration of the spell. On a roll of 1-10, you take the form of a humanoid made of pure, searing light. On a roll of 11-20, you take the form of a humanoid made of bone-chilling darkness. In both forms, you have immunity to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks, and a creature that attacks you has disadvantage on the attack roll. You gain additional benefits while in either form.

entries.name: In Light Form
entries: You shed bright light in a 60-foot radius and dim light for an additional 60 feet, you are immune to fire damage, and you have resistance to radiant damage. Once per turn as a bonus action, you can teleport to a space you can see within the light you shed.

entries.name: In Darkness Form
entries: You are immune to cold damage, and you have resistance to necrotic damage. Once per turn as a bonus action, you can target up to three Large or smaller creatures within 30 feet of you. Each target must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be pulled or pushed (your choice) up to 20 feet straight toward or away from you.

name: Chorus of the Lost

m.text: a silver bell worth 10+ GP

entries: You summon the eerie song and wailing of lost souls from a point you can see within range. Each creature in a 15-foot-radius sphere centered there must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes {@damage 2d6} psychic damage, and it is {@condition frightened} for the duration. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage, and it is {@condition frightened} until the end of its next turn. A {@condition frightened} target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the spell on itself on a success.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by {@dice 1d6} for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Chorus of the Lost

m.text: a silver bell worth 10+ GP

entries: You summon the eerie song and wailing of lost souls from a point you can see within range. Each creature in a 15-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered there must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes {@damage 2d6} Psychic damage, and it has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition for the duration. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage, and it has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn. A {@condition Frightened|XPHB} target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the spell on itself on a success.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d6} for each spell slot level above 2.

name: Circle of Scarlet

components.m: a piece of parchment with a circle drawn in humanoid blood

entries: As part of casting this spell, you must expend four {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB} or the spell automatically fails. A crimson pillar erupts from the ground in a 20-foot-radius, 100-foot-high {@variantrule Cylinder [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cylinder} centered on a point within range. Each creature within the {@variantrule Cylinder [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cylinder} makes a Constitution saving throw.

On a failed save, the creature takes Necrotic damage equal to a roll of the {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB} expended on the spell plus your spellcasting ability modifier. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage.
For each creature that fails the saving throw against this spell, you gain 10 {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}.

name: Claws of Darkness
entries: You shape shadows into claws that grow from your fingers and drip inky blackness. The claws have a reach of 10 feet. While the spell lasts, you can make a melee spell attack with them that deals {@damage 1d10} cold damage.

name: Claws of the Bear
entries: You imbue yourself with the claws of a bear. You transform your arms into a pair of muscular, furred paws and make a melee spell attack against a target. On a hit, the target takes Slashing damage equal to {@damage 3d10} plus your spellcasting ability modifier and, if the target is no more than one size category larger than you, it has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. For the duration of the spell, you can make attacks with the claws.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: When you cast this spell using a 5th- or 6th-level spell slot, the damage increases to {@damage 4d10}. When you cast it using a 7th- or 8th-level spell slot, the damage increases to {@damage 5d10}. When you cast it using a spell slot of 9th level, the damage increases to {@damage 6d8}.

name: Cloak of Shadow
entries: You cloak yourself in shadow, giving you advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks against creatures that rely on sight.

name: Clue
entries: When you cast this spell, all footprints and fingerprints within a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from you become highlighted and glow faintly for the duration. When you cast the spell, choose any point in time up to 10 days ago. Only footprints and fingerprints left between that time and the present will be highlighted. Each creature that leaves footprints and fingerprints is assigned a unique color, but are not otherwise identified. Any creature that moves or touches objects within the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} will also leave colorful footprints and fingerprints, which might reveal {@condition invisible} creatures in the area.

name: Clutch of Darkness
entries: You create a terrible force that slowly crushes the target from the inside. Choose a creature that you can see within range and roll {@dice 2d6} and record the total rolled. At the start of each of your turns, roll another {@dice 2d6} and add the number rolled to the total.
If the total is greater than the target's Strength, it has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Strength-based attacks.
If the total is greater than the target's Dexterity, its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is halved and attack rolls against it have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}.
If the total is greater than its current {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, the target immediately implodes and dies.

name: Coldheart
entries: You cause a supernatural chill to fall upon one Beast or Humanoid that you can see within range. The target must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it receives 1 {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} level.

At the end of its next turn, the target must make another Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature receives 1 {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} level. Then the spell ends. {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} applied by this spell is not removed by the end of the spell.

name: Compel Avarice
entries: This spell twists the target creature's perceptions, inflaming its greed. You choose an object you can see when you cast this spell. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be compelled to try to take that item for itself for the duration of the spell. It will try to steal the item if possible, and if it is unable to, it will fight the item's current holder. If the target is able to claim the object, it will flee from all other creatures to jealously guard it until the spell ends. Creatures that have {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition automatically succeed on their saving throws against this spell.

name: Concealed Shot
entries: A Ranged weapon you touch is made supernaturally subtle. For the duration, when you make a ranged attack using the weapon, the weapon or ammunition you're using becomes {@condition invisible} while in flight and the weapon becomes silent. If the weapon produces smoke or light, the spell suppresses these effects. The weapon or projectile you're using becomes visible again after the attack hits or misses. If you are hidden and the target is 80 feet or further from you, the attack doesn't reveal your location.

name: Concussion
entries: With a thdoom that can be heard 100 feet away, you cause a sudden increase in the air pressure surrounding a creature you can see within range The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take 1d8 thunder damage and become {@condition deafened} until the start of your next turn
This spell's damage increases by 1d8 when you reach 5th level (2d8), 11th level (3d8), and 17th level (4d8)

name: Concussive Burst
entries: A pulse of energy ripples through the air at a point you choose within range, dealing minor damage over a wide area. Each creature within a 20-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on that point makes a Constitution saving throw, taking {@damage 2d4} Force damage on a failed save and has the {@condition Deafened|XPHB} condition until the end of your next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 2d4} for each spell slot level above 1.

name: Confounding Shadows
entries: You create an orb of writhing shadows and hurl it at a creature within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or take {@damage 1d6} Psychic damage and it is unable to see you until the end of your next turn.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Cantrip Upgrade
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d6} when you reach levels 5 ({@dice 2d6}), 11 ({@dice 3d6}), and 17 ({@dice 4d6}).

name: Conjure Anomaly
