m.text: an offering of gemstones, incense, and oils worth at least 400 gp, which the spell consumes, set afire in an alabaster bowl

entries: You exhort a fiend to attack a distant foe. After the offering is made, make a spell attack roll to determine which fiend is summoned:

rows: {@b Wind demon} (see {@i Creature Codex}) or {@creature quasit}
{@b Rattok demon} (see {@i Creature Codex}) or {@creature bearded devil}
{@b Alnaar} (see {@i Creature Codex}) or {@creature horned devil}

entries: Once summoned, you must compel the fiend to seek out a particular creature you choose that is on the same plane of existence as you by making a {@dc 10} Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check. On a success, the fiend slinks off to its target, usually but not always by night. On a failure, the fiend refuses, and the offering and the bowl are consumed in the casting.

The conjured fiend may find that the target is warded or inaccessible or simply difficult to find (whether because of invisibility or some other reason). In this case, you must make a {@dc 15} Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check. On a success, the fiend returns and demands no further offering, reports its failure, and vanishes. On a failure, the fiend returns and demands another offering. If this is not immediately forthcoming, it attacks you.

name: Mortality

m.text: the skull of a humanoid encrusted in gems worth 200+ GP

entries: As part of casting this spell, you must expend five {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB} or the spell automatically fails. Roll the {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB} expended, then choose an Aberration, Celestial, Elemental, Fey, or Fiend within range and condemn it to a taste of mortality. The creature must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or its {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum and current {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} are reduced by the amount rolled on the {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB} expended to cast the spell.

For the duration of the spell, a creature that fails the saving throw loses all damage Immunities and Resistances, its creature type changes to Humanoid, and it takes an additional {@damage 1d4} Necrotic damage each time it takes damage.

If a creature affected by this spell is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, these changes become permanent and the creature dies. This final effect of the spell can only be reversed if the creature is restored to life and targeted by a {@spell Remove Curse|XPHB} spell or similar magic.

name: Mortiferous Pulse
entries: You summon a bolt of negative energy to stimulate and transmit necrotic pathogens into those that stand before you, decaying their internal viscera Each creature in a 5-foot-wide, 50-foot-long line extending from you must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 3d8} necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by {@scaledamage  3d8|2-9|1d8} for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Mote of Hell
entries: You manifest a pocket of Hell. A 15-foot-radius sphere of darkness, brimstone, and blasting heat appears, centered on a point within range and lasting for the duration. The cloud of hellfire echoes with the cries of damned souls that can be heard by creatures within 30 feet of it. No light, even magical light, can illuminate the cloud, and any creatures fully within that area are {@condition blinded}.

The cloud warps the timescape, making the cloud's area difficult terrain. A creature who starts their turn in that area takes {@damage 3d6} fire damage. A creature who ends their turn in that area must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or take {@damage 3d6} psychic damage as the voices of the damned crowd their mind.

name: Murder of Crows
entries: You summon and unleash a murder of deadly crows. Each creature of your choice in a 30-foot cone originating from you makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes {@damage 5d6} force damage and is {@condition blinded}. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage only. A {@condition blinded} creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. The effect also ends if the creature regains any hit points. The crows disperse and vanish after they strike.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the damage increases by {@dice 1d6} for each slot level above 4th.

name: Murder of Crows
entries: You summon and unleash a murder of deadly crows. Each creature of your choice in a 30-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone} originating from you makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes {@damage 5d6} Force damage and has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} condition. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage only. A {@condition Blinded|XPHB} creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. The effect also ends if the creature regains any {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. The crows disperse and vanish after they strike.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d6} for each spell slot level above 4.

name: Murmurs of Doom
entries: You begin a whispered dirge that is magically accompanied by the howling of spirits and other grim portents. For the duration, an aura radiates from you in a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}. When you create the aura and at the start of each of your turns while it persists, you can choose one creature in it to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the creature takes {@damage 3d8} Necrotic damage.

name: Mushroom Ballista
entries: You touch one to three pieces of ammunition and imbue them with a unique toadstool magic, causing them to grow plump green mushrooms around or at the tip of the ammunition.

When a creature is hit with a ranged weapon attack using the ammunition, it takes an extra {@damage 1d6} poison damage and must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is pushed back a number of feet equal to the damage taken (rounded up to the nearest 5 feet) to a maximum of 15 feet. Whether the attack hits or misses, the spell then ends on that piece of ammunition.
If you cast this spell again, the spell ends on any ammunition still affected by your previous casting.

name: Mysterious Presence
entries: You touch a willing creature and shroud its presence. Until the spell ends, other creatures must subtract {@dice 1d4} from any Wisdom ({@skill Insight} or {@skill Perception}) checks made against the target.

name: Mysterious Presence
entries: You touch a willing creature and shroud its presence. Until the spell ends, other creatures must subtract {@dice 1d4} from any Wisdom ({@skill Insight|XPHB} or {@skill Perception|XPHB}) checks made against the target.

name: Negative Image
entries: You create a shadow tunnel between your location and one other creature you can see within range. You and that creature instantly swap positions. If the target creature is unwilling to exchange places with you, it can resist the effect by making a Charisma saving throw. On a successful save, the spell has no effect.

name: Neutralize Aura
entries: You touch a willing creature and neutralize its aura. Until the spell ends, the target can't be perceived by Fey, Fiends, Celestials, and Undead.
The spell ends early immediately after the target makes an attack roll, deals damage, casts a spell, or moves within 5 feet of one of the creature types.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 1.

name: Neutralizing Field

m.text: A delerium crystal or holy relic worth 1,000 gp

entries: You negate contaminated magical energies in a 10-foot radius sphere. Until the spell ends, the sphere moves with you, centred on you. Creatures in the sphere (including you) can't gain {@adventure contamination levels|DungeonsDrakkenheim|12} and have immunity to necrotic damage. Contaminated spells can't be cast by creatures in the area.

name: Noble Sacrifice

time.condition: which you take when a creature you can see drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} or fails its third {@variantrule Death Saving Throw|XPHB}

entries: The creature is restored to 1 {@variantrule Hit Point|XPHB}, and you lose half of your current {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.

name: Obfuscate Object
entries: While you are in dim light, you cause an object in range to become unobtrusively obscured from the sight of other creatures. For the duration, you have advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand}) checks to hide the object. The object can't be larger than a shortsword, and it must be on your person, held in your hand, or otherwise unattended.
You can affect two objects when you reach 5th level, three objects at 11th level, and four objects at 17th level.

name: Obscure Object
entries: An object you can see within range becomes {@condition invisible} until the spell ends. The object can be no larger than a 5-foot cube, and it can't be worn by a creature.

name: Octarine Spray

m.text: a delerium fragment worth 100 gp, which the spell consumes

entries: When you cast this spell, you gain one {@adventure level of contamination|DungeonsDrakkenheim|12}. Octarine rays of light flash from your hand. Each ray is a different colour and has a different power and purpose, see the table below. Each creature in a 60-foot cone must succeed on a Constitution saving throw. For each target, roll a {@dice d8} to determine which colour ray affects it.

rows: The target takes {@damage 20d6} psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a success.
The target takes {@damage 20d6} necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a success.
The target takes {@damage 20d6} force damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a success.
The target takes {@damage 20d6} radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a success.
The target takes {@damage 20d6} thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a success.

At the start of each of its turns, the affected target uses all its movement to move directly towards the closest creature it can see. Then, the affected target uses its action to make a melee attack against a randomly determined creature within its reach. If there is no creature within its reach, the affected target does nothing this turn. At the end of each of its turns, the affected target can make a Wisdom saving throw. If it succeeds, this effect ends for that target.

At the start of each of its turns, the affected target gains one {@adventure level of contamination|DungeonsDrakkenheim|12}. At the end of each of its turns, an affected target can make a Constitution saving throw. If it succeeds, this effect ends for that target, but any {@adventure contamination levels|DungeonsDrakkenheim|12} gained remain.
{@b Special.} The target is struck by an additional ray. Roll again twice. There's no limit to how many additional rays can strike a single creature in this manner.

name: Ode to Wrath
entries: You begin a poetic chant that is magically accompanied by a trio of pounding drums beating an angry rhythm. For the duration, an aura radiates from you in a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}. While in the aura, you and your allies each add your spellcasting ability modifier to damage rolls made with melee weapons.

name: Ominous Winds
entries: Up to three creatures of your choice that you can see within range must make Charisma saving throws. Whenever a target that fails this saving throw makes an attack roll or a saving throw before the spell ends, the target must roll a {@dice 1d12} and subtract the number rolled from the attack roll or saving throw.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Orien Step
entries: You teleport up to five feet to an unoccupied space you can see. You cannot teleport through solid objects or out of manacles and similar restraints.

name: Origami Bird Swarm

m.text: fine papers worth 10 gp, which the spell consumes

entries: A swarm of eight origami birds erupts from the stack of papers consumed in the casting of the spell and flies toward a creature you can see within range. If the target is within 30 feet of you when you cast the spell, the swarm collides with the target, dealing {@damage 8d6} slashing damage to it, and the birds disappear.

If the target is farther than 30 feet away from you when you cast the spell, the swarm travels at a rate of 30 feet per round in the direction of the target, ignoring {@quickref difficult terrain||3} and moving around creatures and other obstructions as needed. While the swarm is traveling, it obstructs a 5-foot-cube area as if it were a Medium creature.
While the swarm is traveling, it can be attacked. It has an AC equal to your spell save DC. For every attack that hits the swarm, the number of birds in the swarm is reduced by one.
At the start of your turn on the round that the swarm reaches its target, the target takes {@damage 1d6} slashing damage for each bird remaining in the swarm. The birds then disappear.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the number of birds in the swarm increases by two for each slot level above 5th; if the target is within 30 feet of you when you cast the spell, it takes an extra {@damage 2d6} slashing damage for each slot level above 5th.

name: Orros Mark of Fate

time.condition: which you take in response to failing a saving throw

entries: If you fail a saving throw, you may choose to succeed instead and then target a creature you can see within 30 feet to suffer the effects of your failed saving throw. You still suffer any effects of a successful saving throw, if any. The new target is entitled to its own saving throw as if it were the original target of the attack but with disadvantage.

name: Osseous Impalement
entries: Massive bone spikes sprout under up to four creatures on the ground of your choice that you can see within range. They must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take {@damage 3d10} Piercing damage and be impaled by the spike, have the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition and be held aloft 5 feet in the air for the duration. A creature {@condition Restrained|XPHB} in this way takes {@damage 1d10} Piercing damage at the start of each of its turns.
A creature can use its action to make a Strength ({@skill Athletics|XPHB}) check against your spell save DC, breaking the bone spike and freeing itself on a success.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage (both initial and ongoing) increases by {@dice 1d10} for each spell slot level above 3.

name: Overgrow
entries: When you cast this spell, choose a creature or an object within range that is Huge or smaller and not being worn or carried within range. Vibrant vines quickly grow around the target, pinning it into place and making it easier to traverse.

If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a Strength saving throw or have the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition until the spell ends. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition on a success.

If the target is an object, it can't be moved from its current location and creatures that climb the object don't spend extra movement. A creature can make a Strength ({@skill Athletics|XPHB}) check against your spell save DC to wrest the object out of the vines so it can be moved. If the object is too heavy for the creature to move, this action fails.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can choose an additional target for each spell slot level above 2.

name: Pacify Monster
entries: You attempt to pacify a creature you can see within range. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw. If it fails the save, it is {@condition pacified|ObojimaTallGrass} by you until the spell ends. A pacified creature can't attack, cast a spell that affects an enemy, or deal damage to another creature. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 4th. The creatures must be within 30 feet of each other when you target them.

name: Pacify Person
entries: You attempt to pacify a humanoid you can see within range. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw. If it fails the save, it is {@condition pacified|ObojimaTallGrass} by you until the spell ends. A pacified creature can't attack, cast a spell that affects an enemy, or deal damage to another creature. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you can target one additional humanoid for each slot level above 1st. The humanoids must be within 30 feet of each other when you target them.

name: Paradox
entries: By twisting the flow of time into knots, you cause one action of your choice taken within range within the last round to be undone. Reality then reasserts itself, recoiling from the damage caused by removing an event from time. The direct effects of that action, such as damage dealt by an attack or spell, are undone, but the indirect effects, such as creatures choosing to move to different locations, are not. The creature that took the action takes {@damage 10d8} Psychic damage, as it copes with its history being modified.

name: Pawn of the Wyrd

time.condition: which you take when another creature takes a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB}

entries: You cast your fate to the winds and accept the guidance of {@deity The Norns|Norse|NorthlandsWorldbook|the Norns}. The creature does not take that {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} and cannot take a different {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB}. If the {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} would have expended a spell slot or other ability, nothing is expended. You lose your next {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB}.

name: Peppermint Plate
entries: A protective layer of hot, hard peppermint icing coats you For the duration, you gain a +1 bonus to AC and if a creature hits you with a melee attack, the creature takes {@damage 1d4} fire damage. This damage can trigger no more than once per turn

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the fire damage increases by {@scaledamage  1d4|1-9|1d4} for each slot level above 1st.

name: Perfection
entries: You speak a holy word and remake a creature you can see in the image of the Arch Seraphs. The {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition on the creature ends, curses on the target are suppressed for the spell's duration, and it is restored to its {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum. The creature's ability scores less than 18 become 18. Depending on the word you use, you also bless the target based upon the Arch Seraph that you call upon:

entries.name: Aphaelon:
entries: The target has {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition. If the target fails a saving throw, it can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to cause the save to be rerolled. It must use the new roll.

entries.name: Empyreus:
entries: The target has {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition, and the target deals an extra {@damage 4d6} Force damage to the first target it hits on each of its turns.

entries.name: Miklas:
entries: The target has {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Poison damage and the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition, and it regains {@dice 4d6} {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} at the start of each of its turns.

entries.name: Morael:
entries: The target gains 30 {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}. When an ally within 60 feet of the target takes damage, the target can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to take the damage instead.

entries.name: Solyma:
entries: The target has {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Thunder damage. When the target takes damage from a creature it can see, it can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to deal Fire damage to that creature equal to the triggering damage.

entries.name: Zabriel:
entries: The target gains {@sense Truesight|XPHB} with a range of 60 feet. At the end of each of its turn, the target can award {@variantrule Heroic Inspiration|XPHB} to an ally that doesn't have it.

name: Perforating Shot

time.condition: which you take immediately after hitting or missing with a ranged attack using a weapon

entries: As your attack hits or misses the target, the weapon or ammunition transforms into a 5-foot-wide {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line} of magical energy that extends out to the weapon's normal range. The {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line} includes the attack's original target. Each creature within the {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line} makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking Force damage equal to the weapon's normal damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The weapon's damage increases by {@dice 1d8} for each slot level above 1.

name: Phalangeal Shot
entries: You point your fingers forward and your phalangeal bones fire outwards, akin to the bullets of a gun. They regrow immediately, leaving your hand unscathed. All creatures in a 30-foot-long, 1-foot-wide {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line} in front of you must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take {@damage 2d8} Piercing damage.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d8} for each spell slot level above 1.

name: Phantom Panther
entries: You conjure a spectral panther that pounces on a creature you can see within range, mauling and pinning it for your allies close in for the kill.

The target makes a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes {@damage 8d6} Force damage and has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition until the spell ends. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage only, and the spell ends. While {@condition Restrained|XPHB}, the target takes {@damage 2d6} Force damage at the start of each of its turns. The target or a creature within reach of it can take an action to make a Strength ({@skill Athletics|XPHB}) check against your spell save DC. On a success, the spell ends.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d6} for each spell slot level above 3.

name: Phoenix Flames
entries: You immolate yourself, consuming your body in a searing cloud of holy flames. You are reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and die, and burning radiance erupts from you in a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}. Each creature in the area must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes {@damage 30d6} Radiant damage and gains 1 {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} level. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only. If this damage reduces a creature to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, it and everything nonmagical it is wearing and carrying are incinerated. The target can be revived only by a {@spell True Resurrection|XPHB} or a {@spell Wish|XPHB} spell.
After 10 minutes, you rise from the ashes where you originally cast the spell. You return to life as if you were targeted by a {@spell True Resurrection|XPHB} spell.

name: Phoenix Flames
entries: You immolate yourself, consuming your body in a searing cloud of holy flames. All creatures within 20 feet of you must make a Constitution saving throw or take {@damage 30d6} radiant damage and gain one level of {@condition exhaustion}. On a successful save, a creature takes half damage and is not exhausted. If a target is killed by this damage, its body is incinerated.
After 10 minutes, you rise from the ashes where you originally cast the spell. You are returned fully to life as if you were affected by a {@spell true resurrection} spell.

name: Pillar of Force
entries: You swiftly stomp your foot, conjuring a pillar of wood or stone that thrusts out from underneath your feet and towards a creature you can see within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 2d12} bludgeoning damage, and if the target is Huge or smaller, it is pushed 10 feet away from you. The ground in a straight line between you and your target becomes {@quickref difficult terrain||3}, with each 5-foot-square portion requiring at least 1 minute to clear by hand.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by {@dice 1d12} for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Pins & Needles
entries: 509509Appendix B | SpellsYou momentarily shut down a small part of the nervous system of a creature you can see within range, before overstimulating it and causing crippling pain The creature must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take {@damage 1d8} psychic damage If the target fails its saving throw by 5 or more, it has disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn as it temporarily loses full control of a part of its body
This spell's damage increases by {@damage 1d8} when you reach 5th level {@damage 2d8} 11th level {@damage 3d8} and 17th level {@damage 4d8}

name: Plummet
entries: You conjure an enormous glowing force, which wraps around a flying creature within range, and attempt to pull it out of the air. The target must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, it is pulled to the ground and takes falling damage as normal ({@damage 1d6} bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet it falls, to a maximum of {@dice 20d6}). On a successful save, the creature drops halfway to the ground and takes no damage.

name: Pogmo's Pot
entries: You summon a cast iron pot in an unoccupied space on the ground within range. All objects within 20 feet of the pot that are neither worn nor carried and that weigh no more than 10 pounds are instantly sucked inside Pogmo's strange container, whether they look like they should fit or not. All objects are stored in an extradimensional space inside the pot until the spell ends, at which point the pot vanishes and the objects it contained appear on the ground in its space.

For the duration, the pot remains sealed shut and the objects inside can't be accessed until the spell ends. The pot is 1 foot wide and 1 foot tall. It can easily be moved or carried and always weighs 15 pounds, regardless of how much the objects it contains weigh. The pot is immune to all damage, but it can be dispelled.

name: Polybrachia
entries: Two muscular arms of brilliant arcane energy appear on a willing creature that you touch. These arms are fully functional and can be used to wield weapons and Shields (allowing the target to simultaneously hold 2 two-handed weapons, or 4 one-handed weapons), perform Somatic components of spells, and perform other actions. For the duration, the target has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Strength ({@skill Athletics|XPHB}) checks. The target can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to make a melee attack using a weapon wielded by the arms.

name: Polychromatic Bubble

components.m: a chip of soap and a drop of oil

entries: You create a shimmering, multicolored bubble around a Large or smaller creature or an object within range. The bubble is a 5-foot-radius sphere that has 10 hit points and an AC equal to your spell save DC. The bubble rises 10 feet into the air along with its contents, up to 30 feet, at the beginning of each of your turns. A creature trapped inside the bubble at the beginning of its turn cannot see or hear anything outside the bubble and must make a Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition charmed} by you and the bubble until the start of its next turn. A creature outside the bubble that targets it with an attack must make a Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition charmed} by you and the bubble until the beginning of its next turn.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, you can create one additional bubble for each slot level above 4th.

name: Portho's Portal

m.text: a silver latch or key worth 100 gp, which the spell consumes

entries: You conjure a portal or doorway that links an unoccupied space you can see within range to a precise location in the mortal or fey realms—such as Midgard, the Shadow Realm, or the Summer Lands—that you have stood. The portal is a semicircular opening, which you can make 5 to 20 feet in diameter—it is often cast under a bridge, archway, or even under roots or branches of a large tree. You can orient the portal in any direction you choose. It has a front and a back on each plane where it appears. Travel through the portal is possible only by moving through its front. Anything that does so is instantly transported to the other plane, appearing in the unoccupied space nearest to the portal. The portal lasts for the duration.
Deities and other planar rulers can prevent portals created by this spell from opening in their presence or anywhere within their domains.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: If cast using a 5th-level or higher spell slot, you may make the portal last for 1 week after you create it. If cast using a 6th-level or higher spell slot, the shadow doorway is permanent until dispelled with a {@spell radiant beacon|bookOfEbonTides} or {@spell wish} spell.

name: Power Word Maim
entries: You command the body of a creature to twist and warp. If the target has 125 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} or fewer, it takes {@damage 8d10} Necrotic damage, and it has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. Otherwise, its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is 0 until the start of your next turn. The target makes a Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the condition on a success.

name: Power Word Shield

time.condition: which you take when a creature you can see is the target of an attack or spell

entries: With a word, a translucent shield bubbles out from a creature you can see within range Until the end of its next turn, it is immune to all damage types except psychic, it has advantage on all saving throws, and all other power word spells have no effect on it. If the creature is {@condition poisoned} that condition is removed, and if the creature is aflame, the fires are extinguished.

name: Pratfall
entries: You cause a small bit of bad luck to befall a creature, making it look humorously foolish. You create one of the following effects:

items: A small, oily puddle appears under the feet of your target, causing it to lose balance. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or be unable to use bonus actions on its next turn as it regains its footing.
Tiny particles blow in your target's face, causing it to sneeze. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or have disadvantage on its first attack roll on its next turn.

Strobing lights flash briefly before your target's eyes, causing difficulties with its vision. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw, or its passive {@skill Perception} is halved until the end of its next turn.
The target feels the sensation of a quick, mild clap against its ears, briefly disorienting it. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw to maintain its {@status concentration}.

An {@condition invisible} force sharply tugs on the target's trousers, causing their clothing to slip. The target must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target has disadvantage on its next attack roll with a two-handed weapon or loses its shield bonus to its AC until the end of its next turn as it uses one hand to gather itself.

entries: Only one of these effects can be used on a single creature at a time.

name: Preserve

components.m: a sack containing a pinch of salt

entries: Food and other perishable items weighing 5 pounds or less that you place in a sack don't age or decay for the duration.

name: Preserve
entries: With a flare of brilliant octarine light, each creature within a 10-foot-radius sphere centred on a point you can see within range must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or become soulbound for the duration, its magical essence tied to its physical (or incorporeal) form If a creature dies while soulbound, its magic is bound to its components for 24 hours allowing harvesting to start at any time within this period (see page 87 for the rules on harvesting). Once harvesting starts on a corpse under the effect of this spell, the spell ends for that corpse Creatures possessing robust or more powerful essence (typically, those of CR 7 or higher) automatically succeed on this saving throw

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the strength of the essence possessed by creatures that allows them to automatically succeed on the saving throw increases by one tier for each slot level above 2nd This impacts creatures with potent or more powerful essence (typically CR 12) at 4th level, mythic (typically CR 18) at 6th level, and deific (typically CR 25) at 8th level..

name: Primal Scent
entries: You inhale deeply, magically enhancing the scents that surround you You have advantage on the next ability check you make that relies on smell, and you can treat a roll of 4 or lower as a 5

When you reach higher levels, this spell gives you an increasingly astute ability to identify the source of the scents around you When you reach 5th level, whenever you make an ability check that relies on smell, you can treat a {@dice d20} roll of 7 or lower as an 8 At 11th level, a roll of 10 or lower is treated as an 11, and at 17th level, a roll of 13 or lower is treated as a 14

name: Primordial Power
entries: When you cast this spell, grant a creature in range a portion of the power of the elementals. For the duration, the creature can speak and understand Primordial and gains additional benefits based on the element you choose when you cast the spell:

items.name: Air
entries: The target has {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Lightning and Thunder damage. In addition, it has a {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} of 30 feet.

items.name: Coldfire
entries: The target has {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Cold damage. In addition, it can use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to expend a {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB|Hit Point Die}, regaining a number of {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the numbered rolled plus its Constitution modifier. When the target takes Fire damage, it can't use this {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on its next turn.

items.name: Earth
entries: The target has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against being moved or knocked {@condition Prone|XPHB}. In addition, it has {@sense Tremorsense|XPHB} with a range of 30 feet.

items.name: Fire
entries: The target has {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Fire damage. In addition, when the target takes damage from a creature that is within 5 feet of it, it can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to make one melee attack against that creature, using a weapon or an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}.

items.name: Water
entries: The target has {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Acid damage. In addition, it can breathe underwater and has a {@variantrule Swim Speed|XPHB} of 60 feet.

name: Protect Threshold

components.m: an ounce of salt for each foot of the warded portal's perimeter

entries: Tracing arcane sigils along its boundary, you can ward a doorway, window, or other portal from entry. For the duration, an {@condition Invisible|XPHB} eldritch creature stalks the warded portal. Any creature that attempts to pass through the portal makes a Wisdom saving throw, taking {@damage 4d6} Psychic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful save.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d6} for each spell slot level above 2.

name: Protection

components.m: a miniature silver shield worth 10 gp, which the spell consumes

entries: You trace a warding sigil in the air, sending it to slowly circle a willing creature you can see for the next hour Immediately before the target next takes damage, except psychic damage, the ward triggers Until the end of the target's next turn, it has resistance to all damage excluding psychic, including the triggering damage The warding sigil then disappears, and the spell ends on the target

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you may target one additional creature for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Protection Rune
entries: You touch a creature, creating a visible rune etched into its skin. The creature has {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to a damage type of your choice.

name: Puppet Master
entries: One creature that you can see within range must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition charmed} by you for the duration.

Magical marionette strings attach to the {@condition charmed} creature's limbs or body, and it must use its action on its turn to make a melee attack against a creature other than itself that you mentally choose, moving to reach the target if necessary. The target can act normally on its turn if you don't choose another creature, or if the creature isn't within the target's reach after it moves. The target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the spell on itself on a success.
On your later turns, you must take a bonus action to maintain control of the target, or the spell ends.

name: Puppet Master
entries: One creature that you can see within range must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition for the duration.

Magical marionette strings attach to the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} creature's limbs or body, and it must use its action on its turn to make a melee attack against a creature other than itself that you mentally choose, moving to reach the target if necessary. The target can act normally on its turn if you don't choose another creature, or if the creature isn't within the target's reach after it moves. The target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the spell on itself on a success.
On your later turns, you must take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to maintain control of the target, or the spell ends.

name: Purge Contamination

m.text: 100 gp of alchemical fluids or holy water, which the spell consumes

entries: You apply alchemical fluids or holy water to a contaminated humanoid creature while reciting an exacting magical chant that expels eldritch contaminants from the target's body. When you finish casting the spell, all {@adventure contamination levels|DungeonsDrakkenheim|12} and mutations are removed from the creature. It then gains one level of {@condition exhaustion} for each {@adventure contamination level|DungeonsDrakkenheim|12} removed with this spell.

name: Purge Contamination

m.text: 100 gp of alchemical fluids or holy water, which the spell consumes

entries: You apply alchemical fluids or holy water to a Contaminated Humanoid creature while reciting an exacting magical chant which expels eldritch contaminants from its body. When you finish casting the spell, all {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} levels and mutations are removed from the creature. It then gains 1 level of {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} for each {@condition Contamination|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} level removed with this spell.

name: Radiant Beacon
entries: A pillar of light falls from the air, filling the square you are in and the area within 5 feet of you. Each other creature in the area must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 4d8} radiant damage and is {@condition blinded} until the start of your next turn. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and isn't {@condition blinded} by this spell. Undead and oozes have disadvantage on this saving throw.
For the duration, a pillar of brilliant radiance shines around you and moves with you. It sheds bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet. The light is sunlight.
This spell's light can be seen from a distance of up to 10 miles outdoors at night or 5 miles during twilight.

name: Rageful Nimbus
entries: Choose a creature within range, which can be yourself. A pristine, fluffy white cloud appears above the target and follows them for the duration. If the target takes damage from a hostile creature you can see, you can use your reaction to make a ranged spell attack from the cloud, provided that creature is within 60 feet of the target. On a hit, the creature takes {@damage 2d8} lightning damage.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by {@dice 1d8} for every two slot levels above 2nd.

name: Ray of Contamination

m.text: a delerium fragment worth 100 gp, which the spell consumes

entries: When you cast this spell, you gain one {@adventure level of contamination|DungeonsDrakkenheim|12}. An octarine ray springs from your pointing finger to a creature that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 16d6} necrotic damage and gains {@dice 1d4} {@adventure levels of contamination|DungeonsDrakkenheim|12}. On a successful save, a target takes half as much damage and does not gain any {@adventure contamination levels|DungeonsDrakkenheim|12}.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 6th. The creatures must be within 30 feet of each other when you target them.

name: Reanimate

m.text: a mélange of wilted daisies and other herbal powders worth 300+ GP, which this spell consumes

entries: As part of casting this spell, you must expend three {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB} or the spell automatically fails. You touch a creature that has died within the last 10 minutes and return it to life with 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point}. In addition, roll the {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB} expended to cast the spell, and the creature gains {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the roll.

At the start of each of the target's turns, it loses 1 {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB|Temporary Hit Point} granted by this spell. While the creature has {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} granted by this spell, it moves with unnatural vigor, gaining a +2 bonus to {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB|D20 Tests}. Once it loses the {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} granted by this spell, the creature gains 1 {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} level.
This spell can't revive a creature that has died of old age, nor does it restore any missing body parts.

name: Reaver's Rune
entries: You touch a melee weapon and place a magical effect into it, creating a visible rune etched into the weapon. No more than once per turn, a creature wielding the weapon can make an attack roll with the weapon with {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} when it would not otherwise have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}. If the weapon leaves the creature's possession, the spell ends.

name: Recall
entries: Record your location when you cast this spell. Until the end of your next turn, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} in response to an attack roll, a creature casting a spell, or a creature moving within 5 feet of you to teleport back to that location, or to the nearest unoccupied space if that space is occupied. This teleportation precedes the triggering attack or spell. The spell then ends.

name: Red Rain
entries: As part of casting this spell, you must expend eight {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB} or the spell automatically fails. Over the course of {@dice 1d6} times 5 minutes, the sky darkens and thick droplets of blood rain everywhere within 5 miles of you.

Each Beast and Plant creature in the area must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition until it has spent 1 minute outside the area. Mundane plants exposed to the rain wither and die after 10 minutes.

For every 10 minutes that a creature of any type is directly exposed to the rain, that creature gains 1 {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} level and takes {@damage 2d10} Necrotic damage. The creature's {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum decreases by an amount equal to the Necrotic damage dealt. This reduction lasts until the creature removes all levels of {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} gained from this spell. While a creature has any {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} levels from this spell, it automatically fails saving throws against removing the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition.

When the spell ends, roll the {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB} expended to cast the spell. Beast and Plant creatures won't return and plants won't regrow in the area for a number of days equal to the roll's total.

name: Red Sign
entries: You reach above your head and conjure the dreaded Red Sign, a sigil of immense power that is inimical to all creatures. At the end of each of your turns for the duration, each creature (including yourself) within 30 feet of you that can see you takes {@damage 5d8} Necrotic damage. This damage can't break your {@status Concentration|XPHB}. If this damage reduces a creature to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, it and everything nonmagical it is wearing and carrying collapses into a pile of slime and viscera. The target can be revived only by a {@spell True Resurrection|XPHB} or a {@spell Wish|XPHB} spell.

name: Regenerative Hull
entries: You touch a vehicle. At the start of each of your turns, the vehicle regains a number of {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to twice your spellcasting modifier. A vehicle must have 1 HP or more to be affected.

name: Reinforce Hull
entries: A vehicle you touch has its damage threshold increased by your spellcasting ability modifier for the duration. A vehicle with no damage threshold can't be targeted by this spell.

name: Repair Hull
entries: A vehicle you touch regains a number of {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to {@dice 4d12} plus your spellcasting ability modifier. The target vehicle must have 1 HP or more to be affected.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d12} for each spell level above 3rd.

name: Resilient Friendship
entries: You magically assist a creature within range, granting it the benefits of the {@action Help} action. If the target you helped successfully accomplishes the task by the start of your next turn, you gain {@dice 1d4} temporary hit points, which last for 1 hour.
The number of temporary hit points you gain increases when you reach 5th level ({@dice 1d6}), 11th level ({@dice 1d8}), and 17th level ({@dice 1d10}).

name: Retrieve
entries: You cause an object within range that isn't being worn or carried to fly to your open hand. The object must weigh no more than 10 pounds or the spell fails.

name: Ride the Lightning
entries: You transform yourself into a bolt of lightning, creating a 5-foot-wide {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line} between your current space and an unoccupied space within 60 feet of you. Each creature in the {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line} makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 4d6} Lightning damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. You then reappear in the chosen space.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d6} for each spell slot level above 4. In addition, the maximum length of the line increases 10 feet for each spell slot level above 4.

name: Ride the Lightning
entries: You transform yourself into a bolt of lightning and teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. Each creature within 5 feet of the line created between your starting point and final destination takes {@damage 4d6} lightning damage unless they succeed on a Dexterity saving throw to halve the damage.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the damage increases by {@dice 1d6} for each slot level above 4th. In addition, you can teleport yourself an additional 10 feet further for each slot level above 4th.

name: Ride the Rifts

m.text: a delerium fragment worth 100 gp, which the spell consumes

entries: When you cast this spell, you gain one {@adventure level of contamination|DungeonsDrakkenheim|12}. A stroke of eldritch lightning forming a line 60 feet long and 5 feet wide blasts out from you in a direction you choose. Each creature in the line must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes {@damage 10d6} lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. You then teleport to an unoccupied space you can see within the line's area.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by {@damage 2d6} for each slot level above 3rd.

name: Riptide
entries: Choose one creature you can see within range that is in at least 2 feet of water and choose a direction Turbulent currents wrap around the creature For the duration, the target must make a Strength saving throw at the start of each of its turns On a failure, it is dragged 30 feet in the direction you chose, and its swimming speed is reduced to 0 feet until the start of its next turn On a success, the creature can move normally until the start of its next turn

As a bonus action on your turn, you can change the direction of the underwater currents The spell ends early if the creature is ever out of the spell's range, or is no longer in water at least 2 feet deep

name: Rocks Fall
entries: Boulders appear in the air and fall in a 60-foot-radius, 120-foot-high {@variantrule Cylinder [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cylinder} centered on a point within range. Each creature in the {@variantrule Cylinder [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cylinder} makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes {@damage 10d8} Bludgeoning damage and is buried under the rubble. On a successful save, a target takes half as much damage only.

A buried creature has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} and {@condition Restrained|XPHB} conditions, and can take an action to make a Strength ({@skill Athletics|XPHB}) check against your spell save DC, freeing itself from the boulders and ending the {@condition Prone|XPHB} and {@condition Restrained|XPHB} conditions on itself on a success.

name: Root Grab

time.condition: which you take when a creature provokes an opportunity attack from you

entries: You cause roots to reach out and grasp at the creature that provoked the opportunity attack, hindering its movement. The creature's speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.

name: Rumor
entries: You magically spread a rumor of 10 words or less in a 100-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from you. Any creature within the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} that can hear and understand three or more other creatures believes that they hear the rumor being repeated by someone nearby. Different creatures hear the rumor from different people, so a concrete origin is impossible to discern. Generally, creatures won't become {@variantrule Hostile [Attitude]|XPHB|Hostile} upon hearing even the most vicious rumors, but hearing a rumor can affect their attitude positively or negatively.

name: Rusting Grasp
entries: You conjure a potent acid at your fingertips, which can corrode metal and burn flesh. Make a melee spell attack against a creature or object within your reach. On a hit, a creature takes {@damage 6d4} Acid damage and it has a -3 penalty to its AC, to a minimum of 10, for 1 hour.

If you target a nonmagical metal object with this spell that isn't being worn or carried, you corrode and destroy parts of the object you choose that can fit within a 1-foot {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube}.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 2d4} for each spell slot level above 3. If you target a nonmagical object, you can destroy an additional cubic foot for each slot level above 3.

name: Sacrament of the Falling Fire

m.text: a delerium fragment worth 100 gp for each participating creature, which the spell consumes

entries: This spell may only be cast in an area covered by the Deep Haze.

You perform a holy ceremony involving up to 12 faithful and willing humanoid creatures that ends when each participating creature drives a delerium shard into their chest. Those creatures become sanctified (see the Followers of the Falling Fire dossier in chapter 3 of Dungeons of Drakkenheim).

When you finish casting this spell, a hostile {@creature shadow} appears and attacks each participant, as a manifestation of that character's inner darkness. The GM may determine that a character who carries great anger, fear, or hate in their heart causes a {@creature wraith} to manifest instead.

name: Sacrificial Siphon
entries: You touch another creature and lay a curse that drains the target's vitality and transfers it to you. The target must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the target is cursed for the duration. While cursed, the target must subtract {@dice 1d4} from its attack rolls and ability checks, and when the target takes damage, you can use your reaction to gain 10 temporary hit points. On a successful save, you gain 5 temporary hit points, and the target must subtract {@dice 1d4} from its ability checks until the start of your next turn.

name: Sacrificial Siphon
entries: You touch another creature and lay a curse that drains the target's vitality and transfers it to you. The target must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the target is cursed for the duration. While cursed, the target must subtract {@dice 1d4} from its attack rolls and ability checks, and when the target takes damage, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to gain 10 {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}. On a successful save, you gain 5 {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}, and the target must subtract {@dice 1d4} from its ability checks until the start of your next turn.

name: Sailor's Shanty
entries: You touch a vehicle. The crew of the vehicle has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB|d20 Tests} to control or operate the vehicle.

name: Sanctum of the Flock

m.text: powdered silver worth 25+ GP, which the spell consumes

entries: You create a 20-foot-radius sphere of faint, shimmering light centered on a point within range. You and a number of creatures of your choice up to your spellcasting ability modifier (minimum of 1 other creature) can absorb empowering magic from the sphere. When any of the chosen creatures finish a long rest in the area, the sphere vanishes, and those creatures gain {@dice 2d10} temporary hit points, and for the remainder of the duration, they have advantage on Charisma checks that use one of their skill proficiencies. Chosen creatures who don't finish a long rest in the sphere gain no benefit.

name: Sanctum of the Flock

m.text: powdered silver worth 25+ GP, which the spell consumes

entries: You create a 20-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} of faint, shimmering light centered on a point within range. You and a number of creatures of your choice up to your spellcasting ability modifier (minimum of 1 other creature) can absorb empowering magic from the {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere}. When any of the chosen creatures finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} in the area, the {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} vanishes, and those creatures gain {@dice 2d10} {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}, and for the remainder of the duration, they have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Charisma checks that use one of their skill proficiencies. Chosen creatures who don't finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} in the {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} gain no benefit.

name: Sanctum of the Shepherd

m.text: adamantine or diamond powder worth 200+ GP, which the spell consumes

entries: You create a 20-foot-radius sphere of faint, shimmering light centered on a point within range. You and a number of creatures of your choice up to your spellcasting ability modifier (minimum of 1 other creature) can absorb protective magic from the sphere. When any of the chosen creatures finish a long rest in the area, the sphere vanishes, and those creatures gain a +1 bonus to AC for the remainder of the duration. Chosen creatures who don't finish a long rest in the sphere gain no benefit.

name: Sanctum of the Shepherd

m.text: adamantine or diamond powder worth 200+ GP, which the spell consumes

entries: You create a 20-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} of faint, shimmering light centered on a point within range. You and  a number of creatures of your choice up to your spellcasting ability modifier (minimum of 1 other creature) can absorb protective magic from the {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere}. When any of the chosen creatures finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} in the area, the {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} vanishes, and those creatures gain a +1 bonus to AC for the remainder of the duration. Chosen creatures who don't finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} in the {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} gain no benefit.

name: Sand Structure
entries: A wall of sand that is 5 feet tall, 5 feet wide, and 1 foot thick materializes from the ground up in an unoccupied space that you can see within range. The sand functions as solid stone while in its wall form. The wall has AC 13 and 10 hit points. Reducing the wall to 0 hit points destroys it and might cause connected walls to collapse at the GM's discretion. You can end the spell early by using an action to dismiss it. When the spell ends, the wall crumbles back into sand.
If you cast the spell as a ritual, the wall lasts until it is destroyed or dismissed.

name: Sanguine Fusillade

components.m: a needle dipped in your blood

entries: You crystalize your foe's blood into razor darts that burst forth to strike your enemies. As part of casting this spell, you must expend seven {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB} or the spell automatically fails. Roll the {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB} expended to cast the spell. Choose a creature that you can see within range. The target takes Piercing damage equal to the roll. When a creature takes this damage, seven crimson darts burst from it.

You can direct each dart to hit a creature within 60 feet of the original target. The darts all strike simultaneously, and you can direct them to hit one creature or several, including the original target. For each dart, make a ranged spell attack against the chosen creature. On a hit, roll one {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB|Hit Point Die} expended to cast the spell, and the creature takes Piercing damage equal to the number rolled.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can expend an additional {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB|Hit Point Die} and create another dart for each spell slot level above 7.

name: Sanguine Poppet

m.text: an object shaped like a creature worth 1+ CP

entries: As part of casting this spell, you must expend three {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB} or the spell automatically fails. You smear the spell's Material component with your blood. The object shudders and becomes a poppet under your control.

The poppet's AC equals 10 plus your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} and your spellcasting ability modifier, and it has 30 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. If your poppet is ever reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} or it is more than 1 mile away, the spell ends immediately. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can command your poppet to move 30 feet, and you can see and hear through it until the start of your next turn.

As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can cause the poppet to detonate in an explosion of blood, ending this spell. Roll the {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB} expended to cast this spell. Each creature in a 30-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on the poppet makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking Necrotic damage equal to the roll on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can expend an additional {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB|Hit Point Die} for each spell slot level above 3. Additionally, the duration of this spell increases by 1 hour for each spell slot level above 3.

name: Sanguine Secrets

m.text: a drop of blood, which the spell consumes

entries: You draw knowledge through the power of blood about a creature you can see within range. You learn the target's species and creature type, its current hit points, and any conditions affecting it. You also learn if it has any of the following, and, if so, what they are: vulnerability, resistance, or immunity to damage or conditions.
Additionally, the next ability check or attack roll you make against the target before the end of your next turn has advantage.

name: Sanguine Secrets

m.text: a drop of blood, which the spell consumes

entries: You draw knowledge through the power of blood about a creature you can see within range. You learn the target's species and creature type, its current {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, and any conditions affecting it. You also learn if it has any of the following, and, if so, what they are: {@variantrule Vulnerability|XPHB}, {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB}, or {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to damage  or conditions. Additionally, the next ability check or attack roll you make against the target before the end of your next turn has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}.

name: Sanguine Shield
entries: As part of casting this spell, you must expend two {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB} or the spell automatically fails. You draw lifeforce from those injured around you to create a swirling shield of blood. You gain 5 {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} for each creature within 30 feet of you that is below its {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum (including you) to a maximum of 15 {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}. While you have {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} from this spell, you have {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Half Cover}. When the spell ends, all {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} from it are lost.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The maximum number of {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} you gain increases by 5 for each two spell slot levels above 2.

name: Scarlet Dawn
entries: Crimson light shines down in a 20-foot-radius, 60-foot-high cylinder centered on a point within range. Each creature in that area that isn't a Construct or Undead must make a Constitution saving throw, taking {@damage 4d10} necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. Constructs and Undead in the area regain {@dice 4d10} hit points.
If any of this spell's area overlaps with an area of darkness created by a spell of 3rd level or lower, that other spell is dispelled.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by {@dice 1d10} and the level of spell that can be dispelled increases by 1 for each slot level above 3rd.

name: Scarlet Dawn
entries: Crimson light shines down in a 20-foot-radius, 60-foot-high {@variantrule Cylinder [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cylinder} centered on a point within range. Each creature in that area that isn't a Construct or Undead must make a Constitution saving throw, taking {@damage 4d10} Necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. Constructs and Undead in the area regain {@dice 4d10} {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.
If any of this spell's area overlaps with an area of {@variantrule Darkness|XPHB} created by a spell of level 3 or lower, that other spell is dispelled.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d10} and the level of spell that can be dispelled increases by 1 for each spell slot level above 3.

name: Seal Spellcasting

components.m: wax mixed with lead and a stamp

entries: When you cast this spell, choose a creature you can see within range. When the target casts a spell, it must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the creature expends a spell slot to cast the spell as normal but the spell has no effect. On a successful save, the creature casts the spell but takes {@damage 3d8} Force damage. After the creature makes a saving throw, the spell immediately ends.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d8} for each spell slot above level 2.

name: Séance

m.text: a crystal ball, deck of tarot cards, or ouija board, and incense worth 50+ GP

entries: You and three or more willing creatures lock hands to conjure a spirit from the afterlife to answer your questions. Describe or name a creature that is familiar to you. If the creature's soul is free and willing, it manifests as a ghostly specter. This spell fails if the spirit was the target of this spell within the last 10 days.

Until the spell ends, you can ask up to three questions of the specter. The specter knows only what it knew in life, including the languages it knew. Answers are usually brief, cryptic, or repetitive, and the specter is under no compulsion to offer a truthful answer if you are hostile to it or it recognizes you as an enemy. There is a {@chance 5} chance that this spell contacts the wrong spirit, one which will answer questions untruthfully or ambiguously.

name: Searing Orb

components.m: metallic flakes and a pinch of phosphorus

entries: You create and hurl a pulsing orb of energy at one creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 3d4} Radiant damage. Hit or miss, the orb then explodes in a flash of light. The target and each creature within 10 feet of it make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d4} for each spell slot level above 2.

name: Searing Sun
entries: This spell intensifies the light and heat of the sun, so that it burns exposed flesh. You must be able to see the sun when you cast the spell. The searing sunlight affects a cylindrical area 50 feet in radius and 200 feet high, centered on the a point within range. Each creature that starts its turn in that area takes {@damage 5d8} fire damage, or half the damage with a successful Constitution saving throw. A creature that's shaded by a solid object—such as an awning, a building, or an overhanging boulder—has advantage on the saving throw. On your turn, you can use an action to move the center of the cylinder up to 20 feet along the ground in any direction.

name: Sense Lifeblood
entries: As part of casting this spell, you must expend two {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB} or the spell automatically fails. The lifeblood flowing within creatures tells you its secrets. Creatures that have {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} condition are {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB|Immune} to this spell. Until the spell ends, you can determine if creatures you can see are related biologically. In addition, you know if a creature's {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} are at maximum, below maximum, at half, or below half.

Once on each of your turns when you hit a {@condition Bloodied|XPHB} creature with an attack roll using a weapon, {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}, or spell, you can cause the target to take extra Necrotic. To determine this damage, roll the {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB} expended to cast the spell.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: Your {@status Concentration|XPHB} can last longer with a spell slot of level 3-4 (up to 1 hour) or 5+ (up to 8 hours).

name: Serpent Tongue
entries: You transform your tongue into a poisonous serpent for the duration. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can make a melee spell attack against a creature within 10 feet of you. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 1d12} Piercing damage and has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition for the duration of the spell.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d12} for every spell slot level above 3.

name: Shackles of Pain
entries: You link the vitality of a willing creature within range—the source—to the psyche of another creature within range—the target The target must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or become linked to the source for 1 minute Each time the source takes damage, the target takes psychic damage equal to half the damage the source took If you yourself are the source, the creature takes this damage immediately before you make a Constitution saving throw to maintain your concentration Whenever the target takes damage in this way, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on a success

name: Shadow Adaptation
entries: Your flesh and clothing pale and become faded as your body takes on a tiny fragment of the Shadow Realm. For the duration of this spell, you are immune to shadow corruption and have resistance to necrotic damage. In addition, you have advantage on saving throws against effects that reduce your Strength score or hit point maximum, such as a {@creature shadow}'s Strength Drain or the {@spell harm} spell.

name: Shadow Armor

time.condition: which you take when you are targeted by an attack but before the roll is made

entries: You can siphon energy from the Plane of Shadow to protect yourself from an immediate threat. As a reaction, you pull shadows around yourself to distort reality. The attack against you is made with disadvantage, and you have resistance to radiant damage until the start of your next turn.

name: Shadow Bite
entries: You create a momentary needle of cold, sharp pain in a creature within range. The target must make a successful Constitution saving throw or take {@damage 1d6} necrotic damage immediately and have its speed halved until the start of your next turn.
This spell's damage increases to {@dice 2d6} when you reach 5th level, {@dice 3d6} when you reach 11th level, and {@dice 4d6} when you reach 17th level.

name: Shadow Blindness
entries: You make a melee spell attack against a creature you touch that has {@sense darkvision} as an innate ability; on a hit, the target's {@sense darkvision} is negated until the spell ends. This spell has no effect against {@sense darkvision} that derives from a spell or a magic item. The target retains all its other senses.

name: Shadow Drain
entries: For the duration, you siphon away the vitality and sense of self through the shadows of creatures within 15 feet of you that aren't behind {@quickref Cover||3||total cover}.

When you cast this spell, you can designate creatures to be unaffected by it. Whenever any other creature enters the area or starts its turn there, or when the area enters a creature's space, the creature must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes {@damage 2d6} necrotic damage and has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage only. A creature makes this save only once per turn.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by {@dice 1d6} for each slot level above 3rd.

name: Shadow Drain
entries: You siphon away the vitality and sense of self through the shadows of nearby creatures in a 15-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from you.

When you cast this spell, you can designate creatures to be unaffected by it. Whenever any other creature enters the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} or starts its turn there, or when the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} enters a creature's space, the creature must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes {@damage 2d6} Necrotic damage and has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage only. A creature makes this save only once per turn.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d6} for each spell slot level above 3.

name: Shadow Gateway
entries: By drawing a circle of black chalk up to 15 feet in diameter and chanting for one minute during the casting time, you open a portal directly into the Plane of Shadow. The portal fills the chalk circle and appears as a vortex of inky blackness; nothing can be seen through it. Any object or creature that passes through the portal instantly arrives safely at the destination. The portal remains open for 1 minute or until you stop {@status concentration||concentrating} on the spell, and it can be used to travel between the Plane of Shadow and the chalk circle, in both directions, as many times as desired during the spell's duration.

name: Shadow Hands
entries: A freezing blast of shadow explodes out from you in a 10-foot cone. Any creature caught in the shadow takes {@damage 2d4} necrotic damage and is {@condition frightened} until the end of its next turn; a successful Wisdom saving throw halves the damage and negates the {@condition frightened} condition.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage dealt by the attack increases by {@dice 2d4} for each slot level above 1st.

name: Shadow Portal

m.text: a silver door latch worth 50 gp, which the spell consumes

entries: You create a door in the nearest wall, cliff, tree, or similar structure. It is immediately bound to a similar door up to 200 feet away. The near door must be a place within 10 feet that you can see while the distant door can be one that you can visualize or that you can describe by stating distance and direction, such as 100 feet straight down or 50 feet to the northwest and upward at a 45-degree angle.

Once the door is conjured, you can take actions normally to open and pass through the near portal, which immediately teleports you to the distant portal. Other creatures may do the same while the spell remains. The spell ends after the duration or when someone closes the distant portal's door as a bonus action.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: If cast at 5th level, this spell can open the door to a shadow road. This may require additional somatic or material components specific to that road, and lacking those, the spell fails and is wasted.

name: Shadow Puppets
entries: You animate the shadow of a creature within range, causing it to attack that creature. As a bonus action when you cast the spell, or as an action on subsequent rounds while you maintain {@status concentration}, make a melee spell attack against the creature. If it hits, the target takes {@damage 2d8} psychic damage and must make a successful Intelligence saving throw or be {@condition incapacitated} until the start of your next turn.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by {@dice 1d8} for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Shadow Step
entries: You can open a temporary portal between two darkened areas, allowing you to move from one such area to another without crossing the intervening space. If you start your turn in an area of dim light or darkness, you can open a portal to another area of dim light or darkness within range and transport yourself to that spot. Doing this uses up your movement for the turn, regardless of the distance traveled. You can use shadow step while {@condition prone}. Moving in this manner does not draw opportunity attacks.

name: Shadow Tendrils
entries: Writhing ribbons of quasi-real darkness extend from your hand. As an action, you can make a melee spell attack with the tendrils against any creature within range. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 2d8} cold damage and must succeed at a Dexterity saving throw or be {@condition restrained}.

A creature that starts its turn {@condition restrained} by the shadow tendrils takes the cold damage again. It can take an action to make a Dexterity check against your spell save DC to free itself. On your turn, as a bonus action, you can drag a creature {@condition restrained} by the shadow tendrils up to 15 feet closer to you.

The tendrils have AC 13 and 12 hit points. They are immune to bludgeoning damage and to piercing and slashing damage from nonmagical weapons. They are vulnerable to radiant damage. If the tendrils are destroyed by damage but the spell is still in effect, you can re-form them on your turn as a bonus action.

name: Shadow Trove

components.m: ink made from the blood of a raven)

entries: You paint a small door approximately 2 feet square on a hard surface to create a portal into the void of space. The portal "peels off" the surface you painted it on and follows you when you move, always floating in the air within 5 feet of you. An icy chill flows out from the portal. You can place up to 750 pounds of nonliving matter in the portal, where it stays suspended in the frigid void until you withdraw it. Items that are still inside the shadow trove when the duration ends spill out onto the ground. You can designate a number of creatures up to your Intelligence modifier who have access to the shadow trove; only you and those creatures can move objects into or out of the portal.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the duration increases by 2 hours for each slot level above 3rd.

name: Shadowy Eruption
