entries: A 20-foot radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} of gloom erupts from a point you choose within range as fell energies from the dimension of shadow flood the area. You select an entity to push through into this reality for a horrifying moment. When you cast this spell, choose one of the following options:

items.name: The Darkness Hides Terrors
entries: Creatures of your choice in the area must make Dexterity saving throws. A target takes {@damage 4d8} Psychic damage on a failed save and must use a reaction to move as far away as it can from the point you chose, using the safest route. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage only.

items.name: Tomb of Shadows
entries: Creatures of your choice in the area must make Constitution saving throws. A target takes {@damage 4d8} Necrotic damage on a failed save and its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is reduced by 20 feet for 1 minute. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage only.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d8} for each spell slot level above 3.

name: Shape Plants
entries: You call upon gentle natural magics to alter the growth of plants. Any plant life you can see within range that fits within a 5-foot cube can take on whatever shape you desire. Additionally, if the plant is a bramble or capable of growing thorns, you may turn the affected area into difficult terrain, causing {@damage 2d4} points of piercing damage for every 5 feet moved through the area you shaped. You may also increase or decrease the number of flowers, vines, leaves, thorns, branches, or fruits produced by any plant you shape.

After one hour, the magic of your spell fades, and the plant resumes its normal shape. If you can use {@spell speak with plants} (or a similar ability) to communicate with the plant, you may persuade it to retain its new form. Different plants have different feelings and attitudes, and if the form is too different from its natural shape it is likely to decline. If the plant accepts, at the GM's discretion, it will retain the form you have sculpted it into, in which case the effect becomes permanent.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot above 4th level, the size of the cube of plant life you can affect with the spell increases by an additional 5 feet for every slot level above 4th.

name: Shared Expertise
entries: For the duration, you radiate an aura in a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}. Choose up to 2 skills that you have {@variantrule Expertise|XPHB} in. If you have no {@variantrule Expertise|XPHB} in a skill, this spell has no effect.

While in the area, allied creatures are treated as having {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB} in the chosen skills. If an ally already has {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB} or {@variantrule Expertise|XPHB} in the skill, they gain no benefit.

name: Shared Judgement
entries: Once on each of your turns when you reduce an Undead to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, you can deal {@damage 5d6} Radiant damage to a creature you can see within 60 feet of you no action required.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d6} for each spell slot level above 4.

name: Shared Vision
entries: You target a willing creature that is familiar to you and within range. For the duration or until the target dismisses the effect on itself as an action, the target can see through your eyes, gaining the benefits of any special senses that you have. During this time the target can swap between their own vision and your vision as a bonus action.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you can target one additional willing creature for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Shield-Maiden's Favor

time.condition: which you take when you or an ally takes damage

entries: A spiritual echo of a Valhallan shield-maiden appears and interposes herself between the triggering attack and its target, then the shieldmaiden vanishes. The triggering attack's damage is reduced by {@dice 1d10} plus your spellcasting modifier.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage reduction increases by {@dice 1d10} for each spell level above 1st.

name: Shielding Word

time.condition: which you take when a creature within range that you can see is hit by an attack by an attacker you can see or fails a Strength or Dexterity saving throw

entries: With a word, you coat a creature in a shimmering shield that absorbs the energy of incoming blows The creature gains 15 temporary hit points the instant before it takes the triggering damage These hit points last until the start of the creature's next turn

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you may choose to either increase the range of the spell by 30 feet or increase the number of temporary hit points gained by 5, for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Shroud Blood
entries: As part of casting this spell, you must expend one {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB|Hit Point Die} or the spell automatically fails.  You can choose yourself or a willing creature within 30 feet of yourself to have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|XPHB}) checks. When the target loses the {@condition Invisible|XPHB} condition, it can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to gain the {@condition Invisible|XPHB} condition for a number of rounds equal to the number of {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB} expended to cast the spell. The target loses the {@condition Invisible|XPHB} condition immediately after it makes an attack roll, deals damage, or casts a spell.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target an additional creature for each spell slot level above 1.

name: Sif's Grace

components.m: two silver beads of equal weight

entries: You grant a measure of {@deity Sif|Norse|NorthlandsWorldbook}'s speed and sure-footedness to a creature within reach. Until the spell ends, the target's {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} doubles, and creatures that make {@variantrule Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks} against the target have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on their attack rolls. If the target moves on its turn, it has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics|XPHB}) checks.
If the target is subject to an effect that requires it to make a Dexterity save, it can choose to automatically succeed. That ends this spell for it.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 3rd.

name: Siphon Contamination

m.text: 500 gp worth of specially-prepared alchemical fluids and a delerium geode worth 5,000 gp, all of which are consumed by the spell

entries: This demanding spell transfers {@adventure contamination|DungeonsDrakkenheim|12} from one creature to another. When you cast this spell, you must first touch either a willing humanoid creature with one or more {@adventure levels of contamination|DungeonsDrakkenheim|12}, or a former humanoid creature whose current form is the result of a monstrous transformation. You then touch a different willing humanoid creature.

If both creatures touched were willing humanoid creatures, you remove all {@adventure contamination levels|DungeonsDrakkenheim|12} and mutations from the first creature, then the second creature you touch gains a number of {@adventure contamination levels|DungeonsDrakkenheim|12} equal to the number of levels removed from the first creature.

If the first creature you touch is a former humanoid who suffered a monstrous {@adventure contamination|DungeonsDrakkenheim|12}, and the second creature is a willing humanoid creature with a character level or challenge rating equal to or higher than the challenge rating of the transformed creature, you restore the fully contaminated creature to its original form, then the humanoid creature immediately undergoes a monstrous transformation as if it had gained six {@adventure contamination levels|DungeonsDrakkenheim|12}.
The second creature touched cannot prevent or negate these {@adventure contamination levels|DungeonsDrakkenheim|12} or an ensuing transformation in any way, or else the spell fails with no effect.

name: Skaldic Scolding

time.condition: which you take in response to taking damage from a creature that you can see within 30 feet of yourself

entries: The creature that damaged you is bombarded with a barrage of scathing insults and must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes {@damage 4d10} Psychic damage and has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition until the start of your next turn. If the creature fails the save by 5 or more, it has the {@condition Stunned|XPHB} condition instead. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and doesn't have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d10} for each spell level above 4th.

name: Skeletal Tail
entries: You grow a long, scorpion-like tail made of sharpened bones. Whenever a creature moves while in a 15-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from you, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to try and pierce them with your tail. Make a melee spell attack roll. On a hit the target takes Piercing damage equal to {@damage 2d4} plus your spellcasting modifier and is pulled to an empty space adjacent to you as your tail drags them in.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 2d4} for each spell slot level above 2.

name: Slither

m.text: ashes from a wooden statue of you made into ink and used to draw your portrait, worth at least 50 gp

entries: You momentarily become a shadow (a humanoid-shaped absence of light, not the Undead creature of that name). You can slide under a door, through a keyhole, or through any other tiny opening. All of your equipment is transformed with you, and you can move up to your full speed during the spell's duration. While in this form, you have advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made in darkness or dim light and you are immune to nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage. You can dismiss this spell by using an action to do so.

If you return to your normal form while in a space too small for you (such as a mouse hole, sewer pipe, or the like), you take {@damage 4d6} force damage and are pushed to the nearest space within 50 feet big enough to hold you. If the distance is greater than 50 feet, you take an extra {@damage 1d6} force damage for every additional 10 feet traveled.

While in shadow form, you can't talk or manipulate objects, and any objects you are carrying or holding can't be dropped, used, or otherwise interacted with. In addition, you can't attack or cast spells while in shadow form.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you can target an additional willing creature that you touch for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Smokescreen
entries: You spew a thick cloud of dense black smoke that forms a 5-foot-diameter, 10-foot-high cylinder centred on you that lasts until the start of your next turn The smoke heavily obscures its area When you cast the spell, you can choose whether the cloud remains in the location where you cast it or moves with you, centred on you

When you reach higher levels, the size of the cloud you can create with this spell increases When you reach 5th level, the cloud has a maximum diameter of 15 feet and a height of 20 feet; at 11th level this increases to 25 feet and 30 feet; and at 17th level this increases to 35 feet and 40 feet You choose how big the cloud is in each dimension up to this maximum each time that you cast it

name: Somnolence

components.m: sand mixed with the spellcaster's blood

entries: As part of casting this spell, you must expend one {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB|Hit Point Die} or the spell automatically fails. Roll the {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB|Hit Point Die} expended to cast the spell plus {@dice 2d12} and choose a creature within range. If the roll's total is equal to or greater than the chosen creature's current {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, the creature falls into a magical slumber for 1 minute. If the roll's total is equal to or greater than the chosen creature's {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum, the magical slumber lasts for 24 hours instead. The spell ends on a target if it takes damage or someone within 5 feet of it takes an action to shake it out of the spell's effect. A creature woken early from this spell gains 1 {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} level.
Creatures that don't sleep, such as elves, or that have {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} condition automatically succeed on saves against this spell.

entries.name: The Long Sleep
entries: Adherents of the Prismatic Circle perform a variation of the Somnolence spell that takes 10 minutes and requires the sacrifice of a Humanoid. These adherents believe when the ritual is completed, it staves off the waking of Gormadraug for a day and night. Through the repetitive performance of this ritual, the Druids of the Prismatic Circle hope to ensure Gormadraug slumbers forever.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You roll an additional {@dice 1d12} and can expend an additional two {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB} for every spell slot level above 1.

name: Song of the Shield Wall
entries: You begin a chant that is magically accompanied by the clanging sound of hammers against iron. Glowing, spectral, circular shields appear before a number of creatures equal to your spellcasting ability modifier who are within 30 feet of you. Each creature gains a +2 bonus to their AC.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: If you cast this spell with a 6th level spell slot, the bonus to AC increased to +3, and if you use an 8th level spell slot, it increases to +4.

name: Soul Effigy
entries: A Humanoid you touch makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a fragment of its soul is bound to the doll used in this spell's casting, which becomes an effigy of that creature. The spell ends if the effigy is destroyed or if the target is on another plane of existence. For the duration, you can use a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to do one of the following.

entries.name: Control
entries: You directly control the target's actions and movement on its next turn by manipulating the effigy's limbs. That target can only take the {@action Dash|XPHB}, {@action Disengage|XPHB}, {@action Hide|XPHB}, or {@action Utilize|XPHB} action. While controlled, the target's movements are jerky and unnatural.

entries.name: Harm
entries: You prod the effigy and deal {@damage 2d8} damage to the target. This damage is Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing, or another damage type, appropriate to the means by which you harm the effigy. This damage ignores {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} and {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB}.

entries.name: Restrain
entries: You submerge the effigy in water, causing the target to believe it is suffocating. The target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition until the end of your next turn.

name: Spark
entries: A spark of bright light arcs from you to a creature within range Make a ranged spell attack against the target On a hit, the target takes {@damage 1d8} lightning damage On a critical hit, the target is also {@condition blinded} until the end of its next turn

The spell creates more than one spark when you reach higher levels: two sparks at 5th level, three sparks at 11th level, and four sparks at 17th level You can direct the sparks at the same target or at different ones Make a separate attack roll for each spark

name: Spectral Fury
entries: You send forth three spectral duplicates of yourself to strike down enemies within 30 feet of you. You can order them to strike one target or several. Make a melee spell attack for each spectral duplicate. On a hit, a target takes {@damage 4d8} damage of your weapon's damage type.

You can then take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to move up to 30 feet in a straight line towards one of the targets without provoking {@variantrule Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks}, streaking through a spectral trail, and make a single melee weapon attack.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage of your spectral duplicate increases by {@dice 2d8} for each spell slot level above 3.

name: Spectral Slash
entries: You send forth a spectral copy of yourself to strike down your foe. Make a melee spell attack against a creature within 20 feet of you. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 1d8} damage of your weapon's damage type.

You can then spend your action to move up to 20 feet in a straight line towards the target, streaking through a spectral trail, and take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action against it. To use this action, you must attack with the melee weapon used for the casting of this spell.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d8} and the distance traveled by 10 feet for each spell slot level above 1.

name: Speechmaster's Rune
entries: You place a magical effect into the stone used as the spell's material component, creating a visible rune etched into the stone. Any creature holding the stone has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Charisma checks.

name: Spell Signature
entries: As you cast the spell you draw out the potent scents trapped within all magic. Choose a magical effect you are aware of that's within range. The effect releases a scent specific to the creature that created it. If you are familiar with the creature, you automatically know that the magical effect was created by them.

If you are not familiar with the creature, you can make an ability check using your spellcasting ability modifier and add your proficiency bonus to it. Refer to the table below to determine what information you are able to glean from the scent. When succeeding on a DC check, you also learn previous information given from lower DCs.

items: DC 5—You learn the type of creature that created the magical effect.
DC 10—If the creature has a class, you learn what it is.
DC 15—You learn if the creature is affiliated with an organization.
DC 20—You learn the name of the creature.

name: Spider Song

components.m: a leg from a song spider or a tiny lute strung with spider silk

entries: You sing a piping tune and conjure shadows into enormous, ever-growing webs. The area within a 20-foot cube within range is filled with shadows, and the area is lightly obscured and provides half cover to any creature within. You may create a new cube of shadows in range every other round so long as you retain {@status concentration}, in which case the previous cube disappears 1 round later. Cubes can overlap but there is no cumulative effect from it.

Each creature that enters the area or starts its turn in the area must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is {@condition incapacitated} for as long as it remains in the shadows or until it breaks free. A creature {@condition incapacitated} by the shadows can make a Strength check each round against your spell save DC. If it succeeds, it is no longer {@condition incapacitated}.
The shadows can be removed from a single 20-foot cube with a {@spell daylight} spell.

name: Spiny Shield

m.text: a small quill

entries: An ethereal barrier of spikes, made of magical force, interposes itself between you and an attacker. Until your next turn, when you are hit by a melee attack, the barrier reduces the damage you are dealt by {@dice 2d4}, and deals the same amount of piercing damage to the attacker. The shield is ineffective against ranged attackers, but still provides a +2 bonus to AC (treat as {@quickref Cover||3||half cover}) against them for the duration.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot above 1st level, increase the spell's effect by an additional {@scaledice 2d4|1-9|1d4} for every slot level above 1st.

activation.condition: When you are hit by a melee attack

name: Spirit Swarm
entries: You invite spirits to take their revenge upon a target. A creature you can see within range must make a Charisma saving throw. The target must have a Charisma of 3 or higher. On a failed save, the target takes {@damage 8d8} Psychic damage and has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition until the spell ends. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage only.

name: Spirit Swarm
entries: You invite spirits to take their revenge upon a target. A creature that you can see within range must make a Charisma saving throw. A creature with a Charisma score of 2 or lower can't be affected by this spell. A target takes {@damage 8d8} psychic damage on a failed save and is {@condition frightened} of you until the spell ends. On a successful save, a target takes half damage and is not {@condition frightened}.

name: Splattering Smite

time.note: which you take when you hit a creature with a Melee weapon

entries: Your strikes drink the splattered blood of your foes. As part of casting this spell, you must expend five {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB|Hit Dice} or the spell automatically fails. Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with an attack roll using a Melee weapon or {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}, roll the {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB} expended to cast the spell and regain a number of {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the numbered rolled.

name: Spore Cloud
entries: You produce a cloud of virulent spores Each creature within 5 feet of you, other than you, must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take {@damage 1d4} poison damage A creature that fails the saving throw by 5 or more is {@condition poisoned} until the end of its next turn
The spell's damage increases by {@damage 1d6} when you reach 5th level {@damage 2d4} 11th level {@damage 3d4} and 17th level {@damage 4d4}

name: Sprout Foliage
entries: You sprout and rapidly grow a lush leafy foliage that covers the entirety of your body. When casting this spell, you can choose if the foliage has other features, such as flowers or berries.

While {@condition prone} and motionless, you are indistinguishable from a normal bush. If a creature hasn't observed you move or act, it must succeed on an Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check against your spell save DC to discern that you aren't a bush. To become disguised again from a creature that has discerned you for what you are, you must take the {@action Hide} action while you're unseen by the creature.

For the duration, you can use your action to create and hurl a pinecone, berry, or flower bud. When you do so, make a ranged spell attack against a creature within 30 feet of you. On a hit, the target takes bludgeoning damage equal to {@dice 1d6} + your spellcasting ability modifier.

name: Stalker's Eye
entries: A willing creature you touch gains a preternatural ability to perceive the weaknesses in a creature's defences. The first time the creature makes an attack while under the effect of this spell, it makes the attack with advantage. After it makes an attack, the spell ends

This spell augments the creature's ability to strike at vital points when you reach certain levels When you reach 5th level, the augmented attack scores a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20 At 11th level, this range is increased to 18 to 20, and at 17th level, this range becomes 17 to 20

name: Steal Immortality

time.condition: which you take when a Celestial, Elemental, Fey, Fiend, or Undead within range that you can see is reduced to 0 Hit Points

m.text: the skull of a humanoid encrusted in gems worth 1,000+ GP, which the spell consumes

entries: As part of casting this spell, you must expend nine {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB} or the spell automatically fails. Roll the {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB} expended to cast the spell and gain a number of {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to twice the roll's total. You gain the creature type of the spell's target, in addition to your own type.

While the spell lasts, you have {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition; you no longer need to eat, drink, or breathe; you have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage; and you gain a benefit based on your new creature type:

entries.name: Celestial
entries: You have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Radiant and Necrotic damage and have a {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} of 60 feet.

entries.name: Elemental
entries: You have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, and Thunder damage.

entries.name: Fey
entries: You can use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to have the {@condition Invisible|XPHB} condition until the start of your next turn, or teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

entries.name: Fiend
entries: You have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Cold and Fire damage and have a {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} of 60 feet.

entries.name: Undead
entries: You have {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Necrotic damage, and you have {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} and {@condition Frightened|XPHB} conditions.
You have the creature type and benefits until you cast the spell again, or you are reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.

name: Stellar Bodies
entries: You create two small stars that orbit you. They twinkle pleasantly, shedding dim light in a 10-foot radius centered on you. The stars protect you. If a creature within 5 feet of you hits you with a melee attack they must make a Wisdom saving throw or take {@damage 1d8} points of radiant damage for each star orbiting you.

Once per round, on your turn, you may use your action to cause a star to streak towards an enemy, expending it as it explodes in a blinding flash. Make a ranged spell attack against an enemy within 120 feet, dealing {@damage 4d8} points of radiant damage on a hit. The target must then make a Constitution saving throw or be {@condition blinded} until the start of your next turn.
The spell ends when either its duration expires, you fall {@condition unconscious}, or you have expended all of your stars.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot above 4th level, you may create one additional star for every two slot levels above 4th. For each additional star orbiting you, the radius of dim light centered on you increases by 5 feet.

activation.condition: If a creature within 5 feet of you hits you with a melee attack

name: Stench
entries: Emanating from a point within range, a noxious, 20-foot-radius sphere of colourless fumes creates a choking, eye-watering miasma that penetrates through creatures' skin

When a creature enters the spell's area for the first time on its turn or starts its turn there, it must make a Constitution saving throw It takes {@damage 3d6} poison damage and becomes {@condition poisoned} until the end of its next turn on a failure, or takes half as much damage and is not {@condition poisoned} on a success Whilst {@condition poisoned} in this way, a creature has disadvantage on saving throws made to maintain its concentration

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by {@scaledamage  3d6|3-9|1d6} for each slot level above 3rd.

name: Sticks to Snakes

components.m: a small piece of bark and several snake scales

entries: You can choose up to four nonmagical sticks no longer than a {@item Quarterstaff|XPHB} (or similar pieces of nonmagical wood, such as {@item Torch|XPHB|Torches}, {@item Spear|XPHB|Spears}, etc.) that you can see within range to shape-shift into snakes. Creatures that are holding a targeted object can make a Charisma saving throw, preventing the target from shape-shifting on a success. Each shape-shifted target uses the {@creature Venomous Snake|XMM} stat block.

Each of these snakes is {@variantrule Friendly [Attitude]|XPHB|Friendly} to you and your allies. In combat, it shares your {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} count and takes its turn immediately after yours.

Until the spell ends, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to mentally command any creature you made with this spell if the creature is within 500 feet of you (if you control multiple creatures, you can command any of them at the same time, issuing the same command to each one). If you issue no commands, the creature takes the {@action Dodge|XPHB} action and moves only to avoid harm. When the creature drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, it reverts to its object form, and any remaining damage carries over to that form.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target two additional objects for each spell slot level above 4.

name: Stone Bones
entries: Choose a creature you can see within range. The target has {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage until the spell ends at the end of your next turn.

name: Storm Door
entries: Crackling with lightning, you teleport up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space that you can see. Each creature within 5 feet of both the space you left and your new space must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes {@damage 1d12} lightning damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

On each of your turns for the duration, you can use your bonus action to call up the lightning and open such a storm door again, targeting a different space with the door each time. If you are outdoors when you cast this spell, a storm develops within 1 minute and follows you. Under such conditions, the spell's damage increases to {@dice 2d12}, and you can teleport up to 240 feet.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, a creature of your choice within 5 feet of you can teleport through the storm door with you. Accompanying creatures do not suffer the lightning damage.

name: Storm Maiden's Edge
entries: You touch a weapon and imbue it with the power of the storm. Until the spell ends, the chosen weapon deals an extra {@damage 2d8} Lightning damage on a hit.

A creature hit by the weapon must make a Strength saving throw against your Spell Save DC. On a failed save, the target is pushed back 10 feet. If the target fails the Strength save by 5 or more, it has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The amount of extra Lightning damage dealt by the weapon increases by {@dice 1d8} for every two spell slot levels above 3rd.

name: Storm Stallion
entries: Choose a 5-foot-cube space that you can see within range. A Medium elemental stallion appears in that space out of a twisting gust of wind and charges in a direction you choose in a straight line up to 60 feet long. If the stallion appears in a space occupied by a creature that is Medium or smaller, that creature must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or be carried along with the stallion as it moves. A creature can choose to fail this saving throw.

Each creature in the stallion's path (excluding the creature it's carrying, if any) must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 6d8} bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The stallion then vanishes.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the damage increases by {@dice 1d8} for each slot level above 4th.

name: Submerge
entries: This spell creates a magical link between a body of water within range and another body of water, at any location within 500 miles, on the same plane of existence. You must have seen or touched the destination body of water at least once before. For the duration, any creature can step into the target body of water and exit from the destination body of water by using 5 feet of movement.

Both bodies of water must be large enough for the creature attempting to pass through to become fully submerged. If either body of water isn't large enough for the creature to become fully submerged, there's a {@chance 25} chance that the creature exits from a random body of water on the same plane of existence.

name: Suffocate
entries: You create a pair of grasping hands made from {@condition invisible} forces. Make a spell attack against one creature that you can see within range. On a hit, the creature is {@condition restrained} as the hands crush their throat or bodily equivalent.

If the creature requires air to breathe, it begins to suffocate. A suffocating creature can survive for a number of rounds equal to 1 + its Constitution modifier (minimum of 1 round). At the start of its next turn after those rounds are over, it becomes {@condition unconscious}, and it can't regain hit points until it can breathe again.
A conscious creature {@condition restrained} by the hands can use its action to make a Strength or Dexterity check (its choice) against your spell save DC. On a success, the spell ends on the target.

name: Suffocate
entries: You create a pair of grasping hands made from {@condition invisible} force. Make a ranged spell attack against a creature you can see within range. On a hit, the creature has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition. While it has this condition, it can't breathe.

A creature can hold its breath for a number of rounds equal to 1 plus its Constitution modifier (minimum of 30 seconds) before suffocation begins. When a creature runs out of breath, it gains 1 {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} level at the end of each of its turns. When a creature can breathe again, it removes all levels of {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} it gained from suffocating.

A creature {@condition Restrained|XPHB} by the hands can take an action to make a Strength ({@skill Athletics|XPHB}) check against your spell save DC. If it succeeds, it is no longer {@condition Restrained|XPHB}.

name: Sugar Rush
entries: Choose a willing creature that you can see within range Until the spell ends, the target's speed is increased by 15 feet, and it gains a +1 bonus to AC As a bonus action on each of its turns, it can take the Dash, Disengage, Hide, or Use an Object action.

When the spell ends, or if an affected creature does not spend movement up to its walking speed by the end of its turn, it then develops a stomach ache and is {@condition poisoned} until the end of its next turn

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd-level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Summer Winds
entries: You unleash a blast of light and wind in a 15-foot cone. Your allies in the cone regain {@dice 2d6} hit points. Undead within the cone that are hostile to you must make a Constitution saving throw, taking {@damage 2d6} radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage and healing increase by {@dice 2d6} for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Summer Winds
entries: You unleash a blast of light and wind in a 15-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. Your allies in the {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone} regain {@dice 2d6} {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. Undead within the {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone} that are {@variantrule Hostile [Attitude]|XPHB|Hostile} to you must make a Constitution saving throw, taking {@damage 2d6} Radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage and healing increase by {@dice 2d6} for each spell slot level above 2.

name: Summon Jack-o'-lantern
entries: A giant jack-o'-lantern rapidly grows around up to four Medium or smaller creatures or one Large creature within a 5-foot radius centered on a point you can see within range. An unwilling creature in the area can make a Dexterity saving throw, leaping 5 feet outside the jack-o'-lantern on a success.

While inside the jack-o'-lantern, creatures can only see through its eyes and mouth, which are on one side of the jack-o'-lantern, selected by you when you cast this spell. The creatures can make attacks with ranged or reach weapons only from this side. Creatures outside the jack-o'-lantern only see a warm, glowing light when looking into its mouth or eyes. While the jack-o'-lantern remains, no creature in, or outside of it can pass or reach through it.
The jack-o'-lantern weighs 5,000 pounds, has an AC of 15, and has 100 hit points. The lantern naturally loses 20 hit points every year. When the lantern is reduced to 0 hit points, it is destroyed.

name: Summon Leviathan Avatar
entries: You call forth the spirit of the mythical leviathan. It manifests in an unoccupied space that you can see within range and uses the {@creature Leviathan Avatar|NorthlandsWorldbook|Leviathan Spirit} stat block. The space you choose must be filled with enough water to contain the size of the leviathan, otherwise the spell ends immediately. The creature disappears when it drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} or when the spell ends.

The leviathan is an ally to you and your allies. In combat, the creature shares your {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} count, but it takes its turn immediately after yours. It obeys your verbal commands (no action required by you). If you don't issue any, it takes the {@action Dodge|XPHB} action and uses its movement to avoid danger.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: Use the spell slot's level for the spell's level in the stat block.

name: Summon Plant

m.text: a ceramic pot filled with herbs and fertilizer worth at least 200 GP

entries: You call forth a plant spirit. It manifests in an unoccupied space you can see within range. This corporeal form uses the {@creature Plant Spirit|GrimHollowPG24} stat block. When you cast the spell, choose a floral feature: Blooming, Oaken, or Thorny. The creature resembles an animated plant marked by the chosen floral feature, which determines one of the traits in its stat block. The creature disappears when it drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} or when the spell ends.

The creature is an ally to you and your allies. In combat, the creature shares your {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} count, but it takes its turn immediately after yours. It obeys your verbal commands (no action required by you). If you don't issue any, it takes the {@action Dodge|XPHB} action and uses its move to avoid danger.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: Use the spell slot's level for the spell's level in the stat block.

name: Summon Sea Spirit

m.text: a bejeweled statuette of a sea serpent worth at least 300 GP

entries: You call forth an abyssal spirit. It manifests in an unoccupied space that you can see within range. This corporeal form uses the {@creature Sea Serpent Spirit|GrimHollowPG24} stat block. When you cast the spell, choose an abhorrent feature: Enormous Mouth, Glowing Lantern, or Scaled Wings. The creature resembles a monstrous sea creature marked by the chosen abhorrent feature, which determines one of the traits in its stat block. The creature disappears when it drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} or when the spell ends.

The creature is an ally to you and your allies. In combat, the creature shares your {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} count, but it takes its turn immediately after yours. It obeys your verbal commands (no action required by you). If you don't issue any, it takes the {@action Dodge|XPHB} action and uses its move to avoid danger.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: Use the spell slot's level for the spell's level in the stat block.

name: Summon Shadow
entries: You call forth a spirit of shadow. It manifests as a silhouette of pure blackness in an unoccupied space you can see within range. This corporeal form uses the {@creature Shadow Spirit|CthulhuTorchlight} stat block. When you cast this spell, choose Infiltrator or Assassin. Your choice determines certain traits in its stat block. The creature disappears when it drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} or when the spell ends.

The creature is an ally to you and your companions. In combat, the creature shares your initiative count, but it takes its turn immediately after yours. It obeys your verbal commands (no action required by you). If you don't issue any, it takes the {@action Dodge|XPHB} action and uses its move to avoid danger.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, use the higher level wherever the spell's level appears in the stat block.

name: Summon Vehicle
entries: You summon a bicycle or moving machine in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of you. The vehicle can be no larger than a 5-foot cube, and it can only carry one creature that is Medium or smaller. The vehicle has a walking speed of 60 feet, which you can use while riding it, provided you have at least one free hand to operate the vehicle.
You can end the spell early by using an action to dismiss it. When the spell ends, the vehicle vanishes.

name: Sun Rune
entries: You place a magical effect into the stone used as the spell's material component, creating a visible rune etched into the stone. You can only have one Sun Rune spell active at a time.

Once while the spell lasts, any creature holding the stone may use an {@variantrule Action|XPHB} to invoke the rune's power and throw it at a target up to 60 feet away. It stops early if it impacts against a solid surface. When the stone lands or impacts, the rune triggers.

When the rune triggers, the blazing heat of the sun flashes in a 30-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on the stone. Each creature in the {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 4d6} Fire damage and {@damage 4d6} Radiant damage, or half as much on a successful one.

Flammable objects in the {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} that aren't being worn or carried start burning. Ice or snow within the {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} vaporizes into a fog that fills the {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere}, making it {@variantrule Heavily Obscured|XPHB} for 1 minute or until a strong wind (such as one created by the {@spell Gust of Wind|XPHB} spell) disperses it.
After activating the rune's power, the creature cannot activate another Sun Rune again until after a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Supernal Smite

time.condition: which you take immediately after hitting a creature with a Melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike

entries: Your strike cause ambient magic surrounded a creature to collapse and detonate. The target hit by the strike takes an extra {@damage 4d6} Force damage from the attack. If the creature is {@status Concentration|XPHB|Concentrating} on a spell, that {@status Concentration|XPHB} is broken.

In addition, each ongoing spell of level 3 or lower on the target ends. For each ongoing spell of level 4 or higher on the target, make an ability check using your spellcasting ability (DC 10 plus that spell's level). On a successful check, the spell ends.

name: Supernal Smite
entries: The next time you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack during this spell's duration, your weapon shatters the ambient magic surrounding the creature, and the attack deals an extra {@damage 4d6} force damage. If the creature is {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell, that {@status concentration} is broken.

In addition, any spell of 3rd level or lower on the target ends. For each spell of 4th level or higher on the target, make an ability check using your spellcasting ability. The DC equals 10 + the spells' level. On a successful check, the spell ends.

name: Swallow Magic

time.condition: which you take when a spell cast by another creature fails to affect you

entries: You chomp down on the threads of magic left in the air after the triggering spell fails to affect you, swallowing the now latent magic and gaining one of the following effects of your choice:

items: You regain hit points equal to {@dice 1d4} + your spellcasting ability modifier.
Your speed increases by 15 feet until the end of your next turn.
Once before the end of your next turn, you can roll a {@dice d4} and add the number rolled to one ability check of your choice.

name: Swarm
entries: Choose a target within range; a cloud of miniscule poisonous spiders floats on gossamer strands towards it The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw to avoid the spiders or become {@condition poisoned} until the end of its next turn

This spell deals poison damage on a failed saving throw when you reach certain levels When you reach 5th level, a creature takes {@damage 1d10} poison damage; at 11th level this increases to {@damage 2d10} and at 17th level this increases to {@damage 3d10}

name: Swift Flight
entries: Streaks of energy flow from the back of a creature you touch, tracing the shapes of wings. The target has a {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} of 60 feet and can hover until the end of its next turn. When the spell ends, the target falls if it is in the air and nothing is holding it aloft.

name: Switched Form
entries: This spell allows you to change the appearance of two humanoids that you can see within range. Each target takes on an illusory disguise, making it look like the other target—including its armor, clothing, weapons, and other belongings on its person. Each creature can seem 1 foot shorter or taller; the disguise otherwise replicates the other target's physical features as accurately as possible. The spell lasts for the duration, unless you use your action to dismiss it sooner.

The changes wrought by this spell fail to hold up to physical inspection. For example, if this spell causes a creature to gain a cape from its disguise, objects pass through the cape, and anyone who touches it would feel nothing or would feel the creature's back or shoulders. If this spell causes a creature to appear thinner than it is, the hand of someone who reaches out to touch the creature would bump into it while it was seemingly still in midair.
A creature can use its action to inspect a target and make an Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check against your spell save DC. If it succeeds, it becomes aware that the target is disguised.

name: Switcheroo
entries: You attempt to switch places with a Large or smaller target within range that you can see The target must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or instantly teleport to your space whilst you teleport to the one it previously occupied
A creature automatically succeeds on this saving throw if there is not enough space to accommodate either of the teleporting creatures A willing creature may choose to fail the saving throw

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the range of this spell increases by 30 feet for each slot level above 3rd The maximum size of creature you can target increases to Huge when cast at 6th level or higher, and to Gargantuan when cast at 9th level.

name: Sword of Judgment
entries: This spell designates an area of protection in a 20-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on a point you choose within range. Within that {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere}, a spectral sword appears over each creature, following the creature as long as it remains within the {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere}.

Whenever a creature within the {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} makes an attack or casts a spell, you can force that creature to make a Dexterity saving throw, as the sword above it falls. Resolve the Dexterity saving throw before the triggering attack or spell. On a failed save, the target takes {@damage 4d8} Force damage, or half as much damage on a successful save. A creature makes this save only once per turn.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d8} for each spell slot level above 5.

name: Talons of the Eagle
entries: You imbue yourself with the power of the eagle. While the spell lasts, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Dexterity checks and Dexterity saves.

As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can briefly transform your hands into a set of talons, then move up to your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} and make a melee talon attack. On a hit, the target takes Slashing damage equal to {@damage 1d8} plus your spellcasting ability modifier.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d8} for every two spell slot levels above 1st.

name: Tamh Gon's Fiery Festival Feast

m.text: an uncommon ingredient, which the spell consumes

entries: You sanctify a meal in an extravagant show of thrown spices and twirling dance. Those who partake in the meal are granted the curry blessings of the great festival spirit Tamh Gon. The feast takes 1 hour to consume and the beneficial effects don't set in until this hour is over. Up to twelve creatures can participate in this feast.

A creature that partakes of the feast gains several benefits. The creature reduces its {@condition exhaustion} level by one, its speed increases by 10 feet, and it gains a +2 bonus to Dexterity saving throws. It can also activate the effects of the {@spell Ember Belly|ObojimaTallGrass} spell one time while the benefits of the feast last. The feast's benefits last for 24 hours.

name: Task
entries: With a flick of your wrist, you magically complete a small and simple task, such as flipping a book page, buttering bread, or heating a cup of tea, without any physical interaction. The task can't include anything that is intended to inflict a harmful effect on a creature and must be something you'd normally be able to accomplish without the use of magic. The spell fails if the target of the task has total cover from you.
If you cast this spell multiple times, you can have up to three tasks active at a time, and you can dismiss one of them as a bonus action.

name: Tentacle Lash
entries: One of your arms elongates into a long, wet, suckered tentacle When you cast this spell, and as an action on each of your turns, you can make a melee spell attack against a creature within 30 feet of you On a hit, the target takes {@damage 5d8} bludgeoning damage and it must make a Strength saving throw if it is Huge or smaller On a failure, you can choose one of the following effects:

items: The target is knocked {@condition prone}.
The target is shoved 5 feet in a direction of your choice.
You disarm the target; you take one item the target is holding and return it to your person.

entries: The tentacle also serves as an appendage that can be used like a grappling hook or rope (GM's discretion).

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the damage increases by {@scaledamage  5d8|4-9|1d8} for each slot level above 4th.

name: The Bends
entries: You assault the internal chemistry of a creature you can see within range, causing bubbles of nitrogen to precipitate in its blood, forcing it to make a Constitution saving throw On a failed save, the target takes {@damage 5d8} poison damage and is {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and isn't {@condition poisoned} If the target is completely submerged in water, increase the damage dice from {@dice d8}s to {@dice d10}s
The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by {@scaledamage  5d8|3-9|1d8} for each slot level above 3rd.

name: Theft of Vitae

time.condition: which you take when a creature you can see within 30 feet of you takes damage

entries: Roll the {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB} expended to cast the spell. The triggering creature takes Necrotic damage equal to the result. You gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the result plus the triggering damage, to a maximum of 15 {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The maximum number of {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} you can gain from casting increases by 10 for each slot level above 2.

name: Thorn Armor
entries: When you cast this spell, a flexible exoskeleton covered in thorns appears around a willing target within range. The target gains {@dice 3d6} {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}. If a creature hits the target with a melee attack roll before the spell ends, that creature takes Piercing damage equal to the number of {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} lost as a result of the attack. This spell ends early if the target has no remaining {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} granted by this spell.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The target gains an additional {@dice 2d6} {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} for each spell slot level above 1.

name: Thought Rune
entries: You place a magical effect into the stone used as the spell's material component, creating a visible rune etched into the stone. A creature holding the stone has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Intelligence and Wisdom checks and on Intelligence and Wisdom saving throws.

name: Tide of Darkness
entries: You unleash a wave of swirling shadows that fills an area next to you. Each creature in a 10-foot {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube} of {@variantrule Darkness|XPHB} originating from you when you cast the spell makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 2d8} Psychic damage and is {@condition Blinded|XPHB} until it is no longer in the area of {@variantrule Darkness|XPHB}. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and isn't {@condition Blinded|XPHB}. The {@variantrule Darkness|XPHB} lasts until the end of your next turn.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The size of the {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube} increases by 5 feet for each spell slot level above 1.

name: Tortoise Shell
entries: You touch a willing creature. Until the spell ends, the target's skin hardens into a tortoise shell while it remains in place, and the target gains a +3 bonus to AC. If the target moves using its action, Bonus Action, Reaction, or movement, the bonus becomes +1 instead until the start of its next turn.

name: Totem Arrows

components.m: a quiver containing at least one piece of ammunition

entries: You touch a quiver containing arrows or bolts, imbuing the ammunition currently in it with the spirit of a creature, plant, or fungus For the duration, any creature hit (or in the case of 'Hawk', targeted) by one of the pieces of ammunition is subject to the effect of the spirit currently imbuing the quiver (see below), in addition to the attack's normal effects. As a bonus action, you can change which spirit imbues the quiver

items.name: Cat
entries: The target takes an additional {@damage 1d6} slashing damage If the attack roll was made with advantage, the additional damage is increased to {@damage 2d6}

items.name: Elk
entries: The target takes an additional {@damage 1d6} bludgeoning damage and must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone} or shoved 5 feet in a direction of your choice (you choose when the target is hit)

items.name: Hawk
entries: The attack ignores half and three-quarters cover

items.name: Hogweed
entries: The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or become {@condition blinded} until the end of its next turn

items.name: Psilocybin
entries: The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or begin 'tripping' for the spell's duration Whilst tripping, the creature must roll a {@dice d4} at the start of each of its turns On a 1, the target is {@condition incapacitated} until the end of its turn and the effect ends. On a 2-4 the target behaves as normal, and the effect continues

items.name: Roc
entries: The target must succeed on a Strength saving throw or its speed becomes 0 and it is lifted 20 feet into the air until the end of its next turn, when it begins falling If there isn't enough room to be lifted 20 feet, the creature is lifted to the maximum possible height

items.name: Snake
entries: The target takes an additional {@damage 1d6} poison damage and must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or become {@condition poisoned} for the spell's duration It can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success

items.name: Spider
entries: The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or become {@condition restrained} until the end of its next turn The target can use its action to make a Strength ({@skill Athletics}) or Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics}) check against your spell save DC, ending the effect on itself on a success

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the duration of this spell is concentration, up to 8 hours.

name: Transient Bulwark

m.text: a pearl worth 10+ GP, which the spell consumes

entries: A fragile, invisible shield protects you for the duration. The next attack roll against you has a -10 penalty to hit, and the spell ends.

name: Transparency

time.condition: which you take when your location would be revealed to a creature while you are hidden or unseen

entries: You temporarily become {@condition invisible} to stop yourself from being discovered by the triggering creature. Until the end of your next turn, you remain {@condition invisible} and your steps make no sound, regardless of the surface you are moving across. Anything you are wearing or carrying is {@condition invisible} as long as it is on your person. The spell ends early if you attack or cast a spell.

name: Tremor
entries: The ground around you in a 15-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} begins to shake violently. You are unaffected by the tremors. The ground is considered {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB} and whenever the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} enters a creature's space, a creature enters the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}, or the creature ends its turn there, the creature makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes {@damage 1d6} Bludgeoning damage and has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. A creature makes this save only once per turn.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d6} for each spell slot level above 1.

name: Trickster's Bluff

components.m: the petrified tongue of a serpent

entries: You are graced with a measure of {@deity Loki|Norse|NorthlandsWorldbook}'s silver tongue. You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Charisma ({@skill Deception|XPHB}) checks. If you fail such a check, you can choose to deal {@damage 1d4} Psychic damage to the creature you failed to deceive, and that creature has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls until the beginning of your next turn.

name: Trollblood Infusion
entries: A creature you touch is magically infused with the regenerative properties of troll blood. For the duration of the spell, the target regains 5 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} at the start of each of its turns, if it has at least 1 {@variantrule Hit Point|XPHB}, and automatically succeeds on {@variantrule Death Saving Throw|XPHB|Death Saving Throws}. If the creature takes Acid or Fire damage, this effect does not function at the start of its next turn.

name: Truth's Blade

components.m: A silver pin, which is not consumed

entries: You punish one who would speak falsely to you. The creature must make a Wisdom saving throw. If it fails, for the duration, it takes {@damage 4d8} Psychic damage whenever it lies.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The amount of Psychic damage increases by {@dice 1d8} for each spell slot level above 3rd.

name: Ugly Duckling
entries: One creature of your choice within range must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the target has disadvantage on all Charisma checks it makes and anyone it speaks to is indifferent to them for the duration. If the target succeeds on a Charisma check while under the effect of this spell, it can make a new saving throw to overcome the effect.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you can affect one additional target for each slot level used above 2nd.

name: Umbral Storm
entries: You create a channel to a region of the Plane of Shadow that is inimical to life and order. A storm of dark, raging entropy fills a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point you can see within range. Any creature that starts its turn in the storm or enters it for the first time on its turn takes {@damage 6d8} necrotic damage and gains one level of {@condition exhaustion}; a successful Constitution saving throw halves the damage and prevents the {@condition exhaustion}.
You can use a bonus action on your turn to move the area of the storm 30 feet in any direction.

name: Umbral Tendril
entries: You create a long tendril of life-stealing shadow that lashes out at a creature in range that you can see.
Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit the target takes {@damage 2d8} Necrotic damage and you gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the damage dealt.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d8} for each spell slot level above 1.

name: Undead Enthrallment

components.m: a clay pot filled with brackish water, another clay pot filled with grave dirt, and a black onyx stone worth 500 + GP for each corpse

entries: Choose a corpse, or a number or corpses, within range that are equivalent to the size of the creature you are animating (the GM determines how many corpses are required). Your spell imbues the target with a foul mimicry of life, raising it as an Undead creature. You can choose for the target to become an Undead creature of CR 3 or lower (the GM has the creature's game statistics).

On each of your turns, you can use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to mentally command any creature you made with this spell if the creature is within 60 feet of you. (If you control multiple creatures, you can command any or all of them at the same time, issuing the same command to each one.) You decide what action the creature will take and where it will move during its next turn, or you can issue a general command, such as to guard a particular chamber or corridor. If you issue no commands, the creature takes the {@action Dodge|XPHB} action. Once given an order, the creature continues to follow it until its task is complete.

The creature is under your control for 24 hours, after which it stops obeying any command you've given it. To maintain control of the creature for another 24 hours, you must cast this spell on the creature again before the current 24-hour period ends. This use of the spell reasserts your control over 1 creature you have animated with this spell, rather than animating a new one. Any creature you have maintained with this spell for 30 days remains permanently under your control. You may only control a maximum of four creatures with this spell.

name: Unraveling Whisper
entries: Choose a creature you can see within range and whisper a frightful phrase that only the target can hear. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes {@damage 2d6} psychic damage and is {@condition frightened} until the start of your next turn. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage only.
While {@condition frightened} in this way, the creature has vulnerability to your choice of bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Unraveling Whisper
entries: Choose a creature you can see within range and whisper a frightful phrase that only the target can hear. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes {@damage 2d6} Psychic damage and has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition until the start of your next turn. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage only.
While {@condition Frightened|XPHB} in this way, the creature has {@variantrule Vulnerability|XPHB} to your choice of Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 2.

name: Valhalla's Cohort
entries: You conjure warrior spirits from Valhalla, the hall of the honored dead. The spirits appear as a Huge cohort of spectral, intangible warriors in an unoccupied space you can see within range. The spirits brandish spears, axes, and blades, striking at anyone nearby. The cohort lasts for the duration, and you choose the spirits' appearance (such as their species and any insignias worn).
You can also move the cohort 30 feet as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on your subsequent turns.

If the cohort ends its move within 5 feet of a creature, or if a creature moves within 5 feet of the cohort, you can make a melee spell attack against that creature. On a hit, the target takes Force damage equal to {@damage 2d10} plus your spellcasting ability modifier. A creature can be attacked in this way only once per turn.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d10} for each spell slot level above 4th.

name: Valkyrie's Guidance
entries: You consult the Valkyries and ask them to guide your hand to glory in Valhalla. Choose a creature you can see. For the duration of the spell, you gain {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on melee attack rolls against that creature and Intelligence checks to recall lore about it. The spell ends immediately if you don't attack the creature on your turn.

name: Valkyrie's Vision
entries: You see how near to death other creatures are. Until the spell ends, you know the current {@variantrule Hit Point|XPHB} total of each creature you can see within 30 feet of you, and you can see how many levels of {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} it has.
As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on your turn, you can cause a creature within 30 feet of you that is dying to become {@variantrule Stable|XPHB}. Doing so ends the spell immediately.

name: Vampiric Claws
entries: You sprout wicked claws. When you use your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} to deal damage with the new growth, it deals {@damage 1d6} Slashing damage instead of dealing the normal damage for your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}, and you use your spellcasting ability modifier for the attack and damage rolls rather than using Strength.

While the spell lasts, each time you deal damage with an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}, you gain a number of {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to your spellcasting ability modifier. {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} from the spell are lost when the spell ends.

name: Vegetable Blade
entries: A lush bunch of vegetable fronds suddenly springs from the ground in an unoccupied space you can see within range. As a bonus action, a creature can pull the fronds from the ground, revealing a root vegetable of your choice that has been grown in the shape of a blade. For the duration, a creature can use the vegetable blade as a melee weapon with which it is proficient. The blade deals {@damage 1d12} slashing damage on a hit (adding your ability modifier to the damage roll as normal), and it has {@itemProperty F||finesse}. Additionally, on subsequent turns, the wielder or one of its allies can use a bonus action to take a bite out of the blade. Doing so heals the creature for a number of hit points equal to the blade's damage die + your spellcasting ability modifier. Once a creature has taken a bite out of the blade, its damage die is reduced by one size—from a {@dice d12} to a {@dice d10}, for example. If the blade is reduced beyond a {@dice d4}, it is destroyed and the spell ends early.

name: Veil of Dusk

m.text: a pinch of soot

entries: You incant towards a creature, cloaking them in a shadowy veil of darkness and silence. The target gains a +1 bonus to their armor class and makes {@skill Stealth} checks with advantage for the duration of the spell.

name: Veil of the Reaper

components.m: a dried corn husk or wheat straw

entries: You wrap yourself in shadows that veil you between strikes. At the end of any turn in which you hit a creature with an attack roll, you become {@condition invisible} until the start of your next turn.

name: Veil of the Reaper

components.m: a dried corn husk or wheat straw

entries: You wrap yourself in shadows that veil you between strikes. At the end of any turn in which you hit a creature with an attack roll, you gain the {@condition Invisible|XPHB} condition until the start of your next turn.

name: Vengeful Blade

m.text: a melee weapon worth at least 1 gp

entries: You brandish the weapon used in the spell's casting and make a melee attack with it against one creature within 5 feet of you. On a hit, the target suffers the weapon attack's normal effects and then radiates a dark aura of energy until the start of your next turn. If the target makes an attack or casts a spell before then, the target takes {@damage 1d8} necrotic damage and the spell ends.

This spell's damage increases when you reach certain levels. At 5th level, the melee attack deals an extra {@damage 1d8} necrotic damage to the target on a hit, and the damage the target takes for making an attack or casting a spell increases to {@dice 2d8}. Both damage rolls increase by {@dice 1d8} at 11th level ({@dice 2d8} and {@dice 3d8}) and again at 17th level ({@dice 3d8} and {@dice 4d8}).

name: Vibrating Humors
entries: As part of casting this spell, you must expend one {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB|Hit Die} or the spell automatically fails. A creature you can see within 30 feet of you must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes Thunder damage and has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|XPHB}) checks from its blood vibrating loudly. To determine this damage, roll the {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB|Hit Point Die} expended to cast this spell.
The target repeats the save at the end of each of turns, ending the spell on a success.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You increase the damage by expending an additional {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB|Hit Die} for each spell slot level above 1.

name: Viscous Sheath
entries: As part of casting this spell, you must expend seven {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB|Hit Dice} or the spell automatically fails. Your body is wrapped in clotted blood. Whenever a creature within 5 feet of you hits you with a melee attack roll, the attacker takes Necrotic damage. To determine this damage, roll the {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB} expended to cast the spell plus your spellcasting ability modifier.

If a creature hits you with a Melee weapon, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to have clots form around the weapon, entrapping it. The attacker must succeed on a Strength saving throw or the weapon sticks to you. If the attacker doesn't release the weapon, the creature has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition while the weapon is stuck. While stuck, the weapon can't be used. The target can take an action to make a Strength ({@skill Athletics|XPHB}) check against your spell save DC, freeing the weapon on a success. The creature can also release the weapon to end the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition.
You can trap a number of weapons equal to the number of {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB|Hit Dice} expended to cast the spell. When the spell ends, the weapons are released.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can trap an additional weapon for each spell slot level above 4.

name: Void Star
entries: You conjure forth a fragment of a dark star and launch it at one creature that you can see within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 6d12} Necrotic damage. Hit or miss, the target takes {@damage 3d12} Necrotic damage at the end of its next turn, and you regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to that damage.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage (both initial and later) increases by {@dice 1d12} for each spell slot level above 7.

name: Void Strike
entries: With a short phrase of void speech, you gather writhing darkness around your hand. When you cast the spell, and as an action on subsequent turns, you can unleash a bolt of darkness at a target within range. Make a ranged spell attack. If your target is in dim light or darkness, you have advantage on the roll. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 5d8} necrotic damage and is {@condition frightened} of you until the start of your next turn.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast the spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by {@dice 1d8} for each slot level above 3rd.

name: Voorish Sign
entries: You have mastered the Voorish sign, a sigil from an ancient era said to predate the world's creation. Choose a creature that you can see within range. When you would normally roll one or more dice to deal damage to that creature with a spell, don't roll those dice for the damage; instead use the highest number possible for each die. In addition, you can choose a spell of level 5 or lower that you can cast, that has a casting time of an action. You can cast that spell as part of casting Voorish Sign, expending spell slots for both.

name: Wall of Death
entries: You create a wall of necrotic energy on a surface within range. You can make a wall up to 60 feet long, 20 feet high, and 1 foot thick, or can make a ringed wall up to 20 feet in diameter, 20 feet high, and 1 foot thick. The wall is opaque and lasts for the duration. When the wall appears, each creature in its area must make a Constitution saving throw. A creature takes {@damage 4d8} necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

One side of the wall, selected by you when you cast this spell, deals {@damage 4d8} necrotic damage to each creature who ends their turn within 10 feet of that side or inside the wall. A creature takes the same damage when they enter the wall for the first time on a turn or end their turn there. The other side of the wall deals no damage.
Whenever a creature takes damage from the wall, you can use your reaction to gain temporary hit points equal to the amount of damage dealt.

name: Wall of Gloom
entries: You create a wall of swirling gray energy, formed of the psychic pain of loss. The wall appears within range on a solid surface and lasts for the duration. You choose to make the wall up to 60 feet long, 10 feet high, and 5 feet thick or a ringed wall that has a 20-foot diameter and is up to 20 feet high and 5 feet thick. The wall blocks line of sight.

The wall sheds {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} out to a range of 100 feet. When you cast the spell, you and creatures you designate can pass through and remain near the wall without harm. If a creature moves within 20 feet of it or starts its turn there, the creature must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition until the start of its next turn.

A creature can move through the wall, though the attempt is emotionally draining. The first time a creature enters the wall on a turn or ends its turn there, it must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or gain 1 {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} level.

name: Wall of Snow
entries: You create a wall of packed snow on a solid surface within range. You can make the wall up to 50 feet long, 15 feet high and 1 foot thick. Or you can make a 10-foot-radius, hemispherical dome. You can shape the wall in any way you choose so long as it makes one continuous path along the ground. The wall lasts for the duration.
If the wall cuts through a creature's space when it appears, the creature is pushed to one side of the wall (you choose which side).

The wall is an object that can be damaged and thus breached. It has AC 10 and 10 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} per 10-foot section, and it has {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Cold, Poison, and Psychic damage, and {@variantrule Vulnerability|XPHB} to Fire and Radiant damage. Reducing a 10-foot section of wall to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} destroys it.
Creatures within an undamaged dome have {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the effects of {@hazard Extreme Cold|XDMG} while the spell lasts.

If you cast this spell in an area of snowy terrain, it blends seamlessly with the existing snow. If a creature takes a {@action Study|XPHB} action to examine the wall, the creature can differentiate the wall from the surrounding terrain with a successful Intelligence ({@skill Investigation|XPHB}) check against your spell save DC.

name: Warp Bolt

m.text: a delerium fragment worth 100 gp, which the spell consumes

entries: When you cast this spell, you gain one {@adventure level of contamination|DungeonsDrakkenheim|12}. An arcing bolt of octarine lightning strikes a creature within range. If the target has one or more {@adventure contamination levels|DungeonsDrakkenheim|12}, it is hit automatically. Otherwise, make a ranged spell attack against that creature. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 6d6} necrotic damage and gains one {@adventure level of contamination|DungeonsDrakkenheim|12}.
You can create a new bolt of lightning as your action on any turn until the spell ends.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you can target 1 additional creature for each spell level above 2nd.

name: Water Bullet
entries: You create a sphere of swirling water that spins rapidly in your hand or mouth before you hurl it at a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes bludgeoning damage based on how far it is away from you.
