items: 1-10 feet: {@dice 5d6}
11-60 feet: {@dice 4d6}
61-90 feet: {@dice 3d6}

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by {@dice 1d6} for each slot level above 1st.

name: Water Whip
entries: Choose a source of water that you can see within range that has a volume of at least 1 gallon Make a melee spell attack against a creature within 30 feet of the source of water On a hit, the target takes {@damage 1d6} slashing damage and, if the creature is Large or smaller, you can force it to make a Strength saving throw, pulling it up to 10 feet towards the body of water on a failure
The spell's damage and distance it can pull a target increases when you reach 5th level {@damage 2d6} and 15 feet), 11th level {@damage 3d6} and 20 feet), and 17th level {@damage 4d6} and 25 feet)

name: Wave of Oblivion
entries: You create a 30-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone} of oblivion. Each {@status Bloodied|XPHB} creature in the {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone} makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save a creature dies, and it and everything nonmagical it is wearing and carrying are turned to dust. The target can be revived only by a {@spell True Resurrection|XPHB} or a {@spell Wish|XPHB} spell.

name: Weave Detonation
entries: An invisible, soundless burst of fate erupts at a point you choose. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on that point makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on all {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB|D20 Tests} for 1 minute.
A creature can repeat the Wisdom saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the spell on a success.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: For each spell slot level above 3rd, you can exclude up to five creatures within the radius from the spell's effects.

name: Weave Entanglement
entries: You imperceptibly tangle the threads of the Weave in a 20-foot-radius sphere centred on a point you can see within range Whenever a creature attempts to cast a spell of 1st level or higher in this area, it must make an ability check with its spellcasting ability against your spell save DC On a success, the spell is cast as normal On a failure, the spellcaster casts the spell and produces an additional effect. Roll a {@dice d10} and consult the following table to determine the additional effect
The spellcaster casts {@spell gravity smash|HelianasGuidetoMonsterHunting}
The spellcaster casts {@spell phantasmal killer}
The spellcaster casts {@spell confusion}
The spellcaster casts {@spell fireball}
The spellcaster casts {@spell zippit!|HelianasGuidetoMonsterHunting}
The spellcaster casts {@spell web}
The spellcaster casts {@spell darkness}
The spellcaster casts {@spell silence}
The spellcaster regains {@damage 2d10} hit points.
The spellcaster doesn't expend a spell slot to cast its spell.

Any additional spell cast this way targets or is centred on the spellcaster, who has no control over the spell's effects. The DC for any saving throws equals the spellcaster's spell save DC In the case of concentration spells, no concentration is required At initiative count 20 of each round, roll a {@dice d20} for each ongoing additional effect. On a roll of 11 or higher, that effect ends

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, you increase the radius of the area affected by 10 feet for each slot level above 6th.

name: Weave Numen

m.text: a mithral sewing needle worth 300 GP+, which the spell consumes

entries: You can sense the presence of magic within 120 feet of yourself. You see a faint aura around any visible creature or object within that range that bears magic, and you learn its school of magic, if any.
In addition, you gain thirteen threads. You can spend these threads to gain benefits as described below, with no action required unless stated:

items: When you cast a spell, you can expend 1 thread to enhance the spell as if you had expended a spell slot 1 level higher than you did and you gain a number of {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to 1 plus the level of the spell.

When a creature you can see within 120 feet of you casts a spell, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to expend 1 thread to interrupt that spell. If it's a spell of level 3 or lower, the spell fails and has no effect. If it's a spell of level 4 or higher, make an ability check using your spellcasting ability (DC equals 10 plus the spell's level). On a successful check, the spell fails and has no effect.

When you cast a spell that causes a creature to be healed or take damage, you can spend up to six threads. The amount of damage or healing caused to one creature by that spell increases by four times the number of expended threads.

entries: You lose all remaining threads when this spell ends. If you spend all threads granted by the spell, the spell ends.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You gain an additional two threads per spell slot level above 6.

name: Weavebend

time.condition: which you take when you see a creature within range casting a spell

entries: You attempt to redirect a spell cast by a creature you can see If the creature is casting a spell of 3rd level or lower, you can redirect the spell If the spell involves a ranged spell attack, you can cause the ranged spell attack to target a different target within 10 feet of its original target. If the spell has an area of effect, you can shift the area of effect up to 10 feet in any direction If the creature is casting a spell of 4th level or higher, make an ability check using your spellcasting ability The DC equals 10 + the spell's level On a success, the creature's spell is redirected as described

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the spell is automatically redirected if its level is less than the level of the spell slot you used.

name: Whelm Weapon
entries: Up to three weapons of your choice that you can see within range become enveloped by water. Roll a {@dice d4}; for the duration, any damage dealt by the targeted weapons is reduced by the number you rolled (to a minimum of 1).

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you can target two additional weapons for each slot level above 1st.

name: Whiteout
entries: You must be outdoors to cast this spell, and it ends early if you go indoors.

When you cast this spell, you create a 20-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} of heavy fog and flurrying snow centered on you. The {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} is {@variantrule Heavily Obscured|XPHB} and the terrain within it is {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}. Any creature that begins its turn in the {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} or enters the {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} on its turn must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or receive 1 {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} level. Creatures that have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} or {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Cold damage automatically succeed on this save.
When you cast the spell, you may designate a number of creatures equal to your spellcasting ability modifier. These creatures do not receive levels of {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} from the spell.
When the spell ends, all snow created by it disappears instantly and the {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} levels end.

name: Wilting Smite

time.condition: which you take immediately after hitting a creature with a Melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike

entries: As part of casting this spell, you must expend two {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB} or the spell automatically fails. The creature loses all Resistances to damage until the start of your next turn. The target hit by the strike takes extra Necrotic damage from the attack. To determine this damage, roll the {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB} expended to cast the spell.

name: Wind Sprint
entries: A turning tempest wind lifts you up and carries you to a creature you can see within range. The next time you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack before the end of the turn, the attack deals an extra {@damage 2d6} slashing damage as the winds buffet the target.

name: Wipe Face
entries: You curse a creature that you can see within range. The target's face is replaced with completely smooth skin, sealing the creature's eyes, nose, and mouth. The creature has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} and {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} conditions and begins suffocating.

At the end of each of its turns, the target can attempt a Constitution saving throw to end the spell. Dealing at least 15 Slashing damage to the target opens an airway allowing it to breathe, but  the curse seals the opening at the start of your next turn.

name: Word of Misfortune
entries: You hiss a word of void speech. Choose one creature you can see within range. The next time the creature makes a saving throw during the spell's duration, it must roll a {@dice d4} and subtract the result from the total of the saving throw. The spell then ends.

name: Wotan's Retribution

time.condition: which you take when a creature scores a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB} against you

entries: You teleport directly behind the creature that triggered this {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} and make a melee attack against it with a weapon you are wielding. You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on your attack roll. On a hit, the creature takes the damage from your attack as well as an amount of damage equal to the damage it dealt to you when it triggered this {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB}.

name: Wrack
entries: Choose a creature that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or be afflicted with excruciating muscle spasms for the duration. A creature affected in this way has its speed halved and rolls attacks with disadvantage. At the end of each of its turns, the target can make another Constitution saving throw. On a success, the spell ends on the target.

name: Wrack
entries: Choose a creature that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or be afflicted with excruciating muscle spasms for the duration. On a failed save, the target's {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is halved and it has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls. The target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the spell on a success.

name: Wyrd Sight
entries: You manipulate the threads of luck and fate to work in your favor. No more than once per turn, you can roll {@dice 1d12} and add or subtract it from a d20 roll made by a creature you can see.

name: Zephyr's Feather
entries: You wave your hand and four alabaster feathers, magically sharpened to a razor's edge, appear and orbit around you until the spell ends. When you cast this spell and as {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on your later turns, you can expend one of the feathers and make a ranged spell attack using it against a creature you can see within 120 feet of yourself. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 1d8} Force damage.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d8} for each spell slot level above 1.

name: Zippit!

time.condition: which you take when a creature within range vocalises

entries: In response to a creature vocalizing, you make a sharp sound and hold a finger up in an attempt to interrupt them The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or become silenced as its mouth is fused shut for the duration If you silence a target that is casting a spell with verbal components, the target's spell slot isn't expended, but its action is wasted

At the end of each of its turns, the target can make a Strength saving throw it tries to tear open its mouth On a success, the target takes {@damage 1d8} slashing damage and is no longer silenced Alternatively, as an action, the target can use a bladed implement to cut open its mouth, taking {@damage 1d8} slashing damage and ending the silence

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by {@scaledamage  1d8|3-9|1d8} for each slot level above 3rd.
